descriptionPlain:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


We are looking for a Vendor Lead to serve as the primary connection between our vendor support teams and the broader Spotify Ads organization. You'll also serve as the programmatic subject matter expert within Vendor Operations, helping ensure technical excellence, scalable enablement, and consistent support across our EMEA and JAPAC Markets. Working across vendor partners and internal stakeholders, you'll identify opportunities for improvement, lead operational initiatives, and help shape how frontline support is delivered across our advertising business.

Working across vendor partners and internal stakeholders, you'll identify opportunities for improvement, lead operational initiatives, and help shape how frontline support is delivered across our advertising business.

lists.content:
• Serve as the programmatic product expert within the vendor operations function, partnering with internal regional leads as a peer on product knowledge
  • Identify technical and functional capability gaps across the vendor support organization and partner with training teams to develop targeted enablement programs that strengthen programmatic expertise.
  • Monitor key operational metrics and quality indicators to identify trends, measure performance, and inform support program improvements.
  • Execute on priority initiatives and workstreams on behalf of management, stepping in where focus is needed across the vendor support model.
  • Identify process, knowledge or skill gaps within the vendor support team and propose actionable solutions.
  • Manage complex escalations with Tier 2 Support, Engineering, Product, and Ad Product Quality teams, ensuring issues are investigated, communicated effectively, and resolved in a timely manner.
  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and other GTM teams to gather feedback, prioritize improvements, and continuously evolve the vendor support program.
  • Identify operational inefficiencies and recurring support challenges, and drive solutions that improve quality, consistency, and resolution times.
  • Own and evolve the vendor enablement framework, including onboarding, continuous learning programs, knowledge base content, process documentation, and training materials.
  • Support the QA process for support agents by reviewing cases, identifying areas for improvement, and flagging opportunities for additional coaching or documentation updates.
  • Work with cross-functional stakeholders such as Product, Product Marketing, Finance, and Sales System and Tooling to initiate updates in the team’s workflows or processes.

• You have 5+ years of experience in customer support operations, program management, vendor management, or a related field, including 3+ years working within the programmatic advertising ecosystem
  • You have hands-on experience working with and managing external vendor or BPO support teams, and you understand the nuances of operating through outsourced support partners.
  • You have deep hands-on experience with programmatic advertising operations, including campaign troubleshooting, DSP and SSP integrations, deal setup, auction mechanics, and campaign delivery.
  • You have the ability to assess the technical accuracy of vendor case resolutions, not just communication quality 
  • You have experience working with global teams that span across different time zones.
  • You are highly proactive, with a strong ability to identify operational opportunities before they become issues.
  • You build strong relationships across functions and are comfortable influencing stakeholders across Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations, and external vendor organizations.
  • You have experience driving process improvements and operational change across complex support organizations.
  • You are detail-oriented, organized, and rigorous in maintaining documentation and processes.
  • You are an excellent communicator who can translate complexity for a range of stakeholders, from frontline agents to senior leadership.
  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where some structures are still being built, and you thrive when given the autonomy to shape how things work.

• This role can be based in London, UK
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person site visits, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

lists.content:
• Partner with the India Sales team and Head of Sales to develop strategic agency partnerships and execute annual enterprise agreements aligned to Spotify's business objectives, including commercial structures, strategic investments, incentives, and joint business plans.
  • Serve as Spotify's trading expert, providing guidance on media trading models, commercial agreements, compliance requirements, approval processes, and internal systems.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with senior leaders across India's leading agency holding groups and independent agencies, understanding their business priorities and identifying opportunities for long-term growth.
  • Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities while expanding existing partnerships through strategic account planning and consultative selling.
  • Lead agency-focused initiatives including research partnerships, innovation sessions, creative workshops, educational programs, and thought leadership engagements.
  • Conduct quarterly business reviews with agency partners to measure progress against commercial objectives and identify opportunities for continued collaboration.
  • Represent Spotify at key industry events, conferences, and client engagements across the Indian advertising ecosystem.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment, transparency, and exceptional partner experiences.

    •

• You have 10+ years of experience in digital advertising, media sales, agency partnerships, or marketing within the Indian market.
  • You have established relationships with India's leading agency holding companies, independent agencies, and major advertisers, with a proven ability to build trusted executive-level partnerships.
  • You have a deep understanding of the Indian advertising ecosystem, including media planning, strategic planning, buying, and programmatic advertising.
  • You bring extensive media trading experience and a strong understanding of commercial deal structures, agency trading models, and local market requirements in India.
  • You have experience using data, audience insights, and measurement solutions to inform commercial strategy and drive business growth.
  • You are a strategic, entrepreneurial, and highly motivated leader who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • You have a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding annual revenue targets through strategic partnerships and commercial excellence.
  • You have excellent negotiation, influencing, and problem-solving skills, with experience navigating complex commercial discussions within the Indian advertising and media landscape.
  • You communicate effectively across diverse stakeholders and enjoy collaborating across teams to deliver impactful business outcomes.

• This role is based in Mumbai.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

descriptionPlain:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer II to join Spotify's Platform Central Data (PCD) squad, a cross-functional Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering team within the Platform Mission. You’ll help build and maintain trusted analytical models, metrics, and data products that power developer productivity, platform health, and leadership decision-making. Working closely with Data Engineers, Product, Engineering, and Platform partners, you’ll translate platform signals into reliable, well-modeled data assets that help Spotify ship faster and safer.

lists.content:
• Build and maintain analytical data models using dbt (or similar SQL-based transformation frameworks) in BigQuery for a broad set of stakeholders
  • Build and operate reliable data pipelines using SQL, with a focus on testing, observability, and CI/CD
  • Help define and evolve key metrics for platform health, developer productivity, and ML/AI platform adoption
  • Partner with Data Engineers on upstream pipelines and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to scope and deliver insights
  • Improve data quality, performance, and cost efficiency across pipelines and models, including troubleshooting and backfills
  • Contribute to dashboards and self-serve data products that enable better decision-making across teams
  • Follow and contribute to data quality, testing, and documentation practices across the analytics layer
  • Participate in a fair support rotation for key datasets, pipelines, and analytical products

• You have 2+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related field
  • You have strong SQL skills and experience with data modelling
  • You are experienced with dbt (or similar SQL-based transformation frameworks) and a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks SQL
  • You are familiar with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Flyte
  • You care about data quality, reliability, and testability
  • You are comfortable working with BI/visualisation tools such as Looker or Tableau
  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners
  • You are able to prioritize and deliver in a fast-moving environment
  • You have experience with platform or developer productivity data, experimentation, or ML/AI metrics

This role is based in London or Stockholm. 
 
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Our mission on the Advertising Product & Technology team is to build a next generation advertising platform that aligns with our unique value proposition for audio and video. We work to scale the user experience for hundreds of millions of fans and hundreds of thousands of advertisers. This scale brings unique challenges as well as tremendous opportunities for our artists and creators.


Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts.
Our Advertising Product & Technology team is building the next generation advertising platform for audio and video at Spotify. We create thoughtful, non-interruptive ad experiences that power free listening for hundreds of millions of fans around the world. From display to video, our work lives across some of the most highly trafficked surfaces in the app—helping connect listeners, creators, and advertisers in meaningful ways.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Android, iOS, backend, and web, along with product, design, and data partners to ship impactful features

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
The Stream Reporting team is responsible for capturing and processing the consumption signals that power some of Spotify’s most important experiences and business functions. Our systems help ensure accurate royalty reporting, support experimentation and analytics, and provide trusted data that informs recommendations and personalization across Spotify.
We’re looking for an Android Engineer to join a highly collaborative team working at the intersection of mobile development, data, and platform systems. This is an opportunity to build software that operates at Spotify scale and helps power experiences used by millions of listeners every day. You’ll help shape how listening and engagement signals are captured across Spotify’s mobile experiences and transformed into trusted datasets used throughout the company.

lists.content:
• Develop and maintain mobile client components that capture and report listening and user behavior signals across Spotify.

  • Build high-quality, well-tested, and well-documented Kotlin code that contributes to business-critical datasets used for royalty reporting, analytics, experimentation, and personalization.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Android, iOS, backend, and data teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

  • Help improve the architecture, reliability, and quality of the systems used to collect and process user behavior signals.

  • Contribute to new capabilities that enable Spotify to capture richer listening and engagement signals across evolving product experiences.

  • Drive technical improvements that make it easier for teams across Spotify to add, validate, and maintain event reporting integrations.

  • Use modern AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows to improve productivity and software quality.

descriptionBody:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Stream Reporting team is responsible for capturing and processing the consumption signals that power some of Spotify’s most important experiences and business functions. Our systems help ensure accurate royalty reporting, support experimentation and analytics, and provide trusted data that informs recommendations and personalization across Spotify.

We’re looking for an Android Engineer to join a highly collaborative team working at the intersection of mobile development, data, and platform systems. This is an opportunity to build software that operates at Spotify scale and helps power experiences used by millions of listeners every day. You’ll help shape how listening and engagement signals are captured across Spotify’s mobile experiences and transformed into trusted datasets used throughout the company.

descriptionPlain:
We are looking for a strategic-minded, execution-oriented Artists & Label Partnerships Manager for Taiwan, to join Spotify’s Music team based in Taipei. In this role, you will be part of the Music team in Southeast Asia, reporting to the regional Head of Artists & Label Partnerships.
 
You will sit at the heart of the music ecosystem, moving between high-level release strategies and the day-to-day tactical execution that drives artist and business growth. This role is perfect for a music industry professional who thrives on building relationships and navigating the intersection of technology and creativity.
 
Our ideal candidate has fun at work and a desire to make a positive impact on the music industry as a whole. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape. This role is based in Taipei and will require international travel occasionally.

lists.content:

  • Develop and execute a holistic music strategy for Taiwan that aligns with regional business goals
  • You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, executing on creative and cross-functional collaborations in the region and beyond, building impactful and innovative artist partnerships to enable artists and artist-fan engagement
  • You will proactively identify music trends, emerging talent and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, providing deep cultural and musical insights with the local SEA team to execute pivotal initiatives, your global counterparts on multi-market campaigns and other key internal partners & teams including editorial, artist marketing, consumer marketing, licensing and others
  • Support and educate our key partners across artists and labels communities in Taiwan on Spotify tools, resources and insights to encourage them and improve their daily business
  • Lead artists & label partnerships representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets at both a regional and global level
  • Ensure Spotify has the best possible content offering in Taiwan and use this to further Spotify’s appeal to existing and new users
  • Work with regional Editorial teams and regional Genre Groups on high priority releases, as well as other cross-functional teams to progress towards various content objectives
  • Connect other Spotify teams with the music industry to help drive and execute opportunities driven by Spotify and our partners. You will act as liaison between Spotify and artist / label partners.

• You have at least 7+ years of working experience with label and artist relations in an established digital music service, record label, media or tech company. Regional and global experience would be an added advantage
  • You have a deep understanding and established network within the local music industry in Taiwan and have built relevant contacts with labels and artists to effectively collaborate with the community
  • You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify’s role in the music industry both locally and globally
  • You are skilled at leveraging data and audience insights to support strategic decisions and build clear narratives
  • You are culturally aware, with the ability to critically evaluate music trends, emerging movements and audience behaviour beyond just data
  • You are a confident storyteller and public speaker. You are able to prepare and deliver executive level presentations, effectively advocate for the market and secure stakeholder buy-in with ease
  • You are well organised and detail-oriented with the ability to plan, deliver on tight deadlines and pay outstanding attention to detail
  • You are at ease and have proven experience navigating fast-changing priorities in a dynamic environment, comfortable navigating complex global-to-local organizational structures and aligning cross-functional teams around Music priorities
  • You have strong project management skills with a consistent record in marketing and operations
  • You have excellent negotiation and people skills and consistently demonstrates a positive attitude
  • You have experience working within Taiwan and ideally across multiple markets within regional and global teams
  • Fluent in English and Mandarin. Fluency in regional languages would be an added advantage

• This role is based in Taipei
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

descriptionPlain:
The Audiobooks Mission is a team in the Product & Technology organisation focused on the ecosystem and strategies of Audiobooks on Spotify. We work across both the creator and consumer audiobooks ecosystems, in order to get the best possible product to market with the best possible content.
Spotify's Audiobooks team is helping shape the future of audio storytelling by bringing the world's best audiobook experiences to millions of listeners. As Associate Manager, Audiobook Licensing & Author Partnerships, you'll play an important role in growing our catalog while building meaningful relationships across the independent publishing community.
You'll work with entrepreneurial authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners to identify great content, negotiate commercial partnerships, and help creators succeed on Spotify. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, and Finance, you'll help scale our audiobook business while creating exceptional experiences for both creators and listeners.

Spotify's Audiobooks team is helping shape the future of audio storytelling by bringing the world's best audiobook experiences to millions of listeners. As Associate Manager, Audiobook Licensing & Author Partnerships, you'll play an important role in growing our catalog while building meaningful relationships across the independent publishing community.

You'll work with entrepreneurial authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners to identify great content, negotiate commercial partnerships, and help creators succeed on Spotify. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, and Finance, you'll help scale our audiobook business while creating exceptional experiences for both creators and listeners.

lists.content:
• Identify and evaluate audiobook catalogs from independent authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners that will resonate with Spotify listeners.
  • Negotiate audiobook licensing agreements and commercial partnerships that create long-term value for Spotify and our publishing partners.
  • Build trusted relationships across a diverse portfolio of independent publishers, distributors, and authors, serving as their primary strategic contact.
  • Develop creative partnership structures that support sustainable growth while meeting the evolving needs of creators and publishing businesses.
  • Use market insights, performance analytics, and commercial data to inform acquisition strategies and identify new partnership opportunities.
  • Partner with creators and publishers to optimize catalog performance, improve discoverability, and resolve operational challenges.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to improve partner experience and support Spotify's audiobook strategy.
  • Advocate internally for the needs of independent creators and publishers, helping shape future product capabilities and strategic initiatives.
  • Contribute to initiatives focused on catalog expansion, subscriber value, listening growth, operational excellence, and blended cost per content hour (CPCH) optimization.

• You have 3+ years of experience in publishing, digital media, business development, content licensing, content partnerships, or a related field.
  • You have experience negotiating and closing commercial licensing, distribution, or partnership agreements.
  • You have a strong understanding of the independent publishing ecosystem, including indie authors, hybrid publishers, audiobook distributors, and digital publishing models.
  • You understand the unique opportunities and challenges facing entrepreneurial creators and independent publishing businesses.
  • You build trusted relationships and effectively influence a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • You use data, financial insights, and market trends to inform commercial decisions and partnership strategies.
  • You manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining strong attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership, and finding practical solutions to complex business challenges.
  • You care about helping creators succeed and are passionate about audiobooks, storytelling, and the evolving creator economy.
  • You hold a Bachelor's degree; an MBA or other advanced degree is beneficial.
  • You are comfortable collaborating across multiple time zones and are willing to travel when needed.
• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.

categories.team: Advertising Sales - Emerging and Scaled Sales

descriptionPlain:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


The Emerging & Scaled team is focused on unlocking growth from new and growing advertisers across Spotify’s ads business. The New Business team brings first-time advertisers onto the platform and builds the foundation for long-term partnerships. Germany is a key market within our Northern Europe E&S organization. Based in London, you will partner closely with our existing German Client Partners and Sales leadership to build a dedicated New Business pipeline and expand Spotify’s advertiser base across Germany.
This role focuses on new business acquisition. You will source, qualify, and close net-new advertisers, building relationships from scratch and converting first-time buyers into long-term Spotify partners. Reporting to the Head of E&S Europe, you will be part of a dedicated cross-market New Business team focused on net-new advertiser acquisition and revenue growth across Europe.
You’re motivated, proactive, and energized by building new relationships.. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how new advertisers discover Spotify and elevate their connection to our platform.

lists.content:
•   New Business Acquisition: Own a portfolio of prospective accounts across the German market, proactively identifying, qualifying, and converting net-new advertisers into active Spotify partners through proactive outbound prospecting.

•   Outreach & Prospecting: Execute multi-channel outreach motions including account research, persona mapping, personalized email sequences, and LinkedIn engagement. Create and leverage mockups (audio, video, display) to drive responsiveness and first-time advertiser adoption.

•   Pipeline Management: Maintain a healthy pipeline with rigorous Salesforce hygiene, accurate forecasting, and consistent meeting cadence. Drive toward quarterly net-new revenue targets and advertiser onboarding milestones.

•   Client Activation: Close deals and onboard new advertisers, ensuring strong activation on Spotify Ads Manager and biddable channels. Monitor account performance after activation.

•   Collaboration & Handoffs: Partner with existing accounts that are lapsed or dormant, and build new top-of-funnel pipeline opportunities. Collaborate with existing Client Partners to ensure smooth account transitions when accounts graduate beyond New Business thresholds.

•   Product Expertise: Develop deep expertise in Spotify’s ad products, formats, and buying channels. Stay ahead of product innovations and monitor marketplace shifts to continuously refine your prospecting approach.

•   Market Development: Build relationships with key agencies and holding companies in Germany to unlock new brand-direct and agency-led opportunities.

•   Hunter Mentality: You have 4+ years of experience in digital media sales minimum, ideally in a New Business or acquisition-focused role. You excel at cold outreach, account mapping, competitive research, and crafting personalized messaging that drives response.

•   Organized & Self-Reliant: You independently manage a high-volume book of prospective accounts with confidence, prioritizing engagements with efficiency.

•   Articulate: You are an effective communicator, clearly articulating Spotify’s value proposition and understanding client business needs.

•   Intrinsically Motivated: You are driven by your own goals and always aim to beat your personal best. You thrive on building something new.

•   Commercially Driven: You thrive on exceeding targets and making a tangible impact. Experience in ad tech, programmatic, or audio advertising is a plus.

•   Team-Oriented: You believe in collaborative success, eager to learn from your peers and share your expertise.

•   Fluent German and English language, spoken and written, is required.

•   Please apply with a CV in English.

• This role is based in London

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week and are open to periodic travel across Germany for client meetings, events, and team collaboration.

descriptionBody:

This role focuses on new business acquisition. You will source, qualify, and close net-new advertisers, building relationships from scratch and converting first-time buyers into long-term Spotify partners. Reporting to the Head of E&S Europe, you will be part of a dedicated cross-market New Business team focused on net-new advertiser acquisition and revenue growth across Europe.

You’re motivated, proactive, and energized by building new relationships.. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how new advertisers discover Spotify and elevate their connection to our platform.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify's growth depends on offering the right thing to the right listener at the right price, moving beyond one-size-fits-all packaging toward a portfolio where listeners can mix and match what they value most. The evolution of our subscription portfolio, and how we monetize it, is one of Spotify’s most important strategic opportunities in the years ahead.
We’re looking for an Associate Director to lead the strategic design of that portfolio end to end, shaping the architecture of tiers, add-ons, bundles, and the broader pricing ecosystem. This role will help define how the portfolio works today and how it evolves over the coming years to better serve listeners while driving sustainable growth.
As the strategic engine behind our portfolio architecture, you’ll combine commercial intuition, consumer understanding, behavioral data, and real-world market signals to build conviction behind critical decisions. Working closely with cross-functional partners and senior leaders, you’ll help determine what belongs in Premium, what moves into new monetization layers, and how Spotify’s subscription offering continues to evolve for millions of listeners around the world.

lists.content:
• Own the architecture of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including tier structure, add-ons, bundles, and how features are allocated across them.
  • Set the logic of the price ladder, including relative pricing, upgrade paths, and how regional ladders work across developed and emerging markets.
  • Drive the insight agenda with Consumer Insights and Analytics, shaping hypotheses, sequencing research, and translating findings into clear portfolio strategy recommendations.
  • Partner with GTM Enablement and cross-functional teams to design, read, and apply in-market tests that connect consumer research with real behavior.
  • Build the business case for portfolio decisions, including sizing, contribution logic, trade-offs, and long-term commercial impact.
  • Drive alignment across Product, Finance, Pricing, Legal, Licensing, and senior leadership on key architecture decisions.
  • Influence the product roadmap so what gets built reflects willingness-to-pay signals, consumer needs, and portfolio strategy.
  • Own the multi-year evolution of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including where the portfolio should sit two-to-three years out and the sequence of moves to get there.

• You have deep commercial strategy experience in pricing, packaging, monetization, subscriptions, or consumer businesses.
  • You think structurally and can reason across an entire packaging-and-pricing system, not just a single product, feature, or number.
  • You have strong intuition for consumer behavior and behavioral economics, including how people perceive value, compare tiers, and make purchase decisions.
  • You have a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and building cross-functional consensus without direct authority.
  • You can move fluently between consumer language and commercial logic, and you are comfortable being the voice of the consumer in strategic discussions.
  • You have experience with Good-Better-Best architectures, feature gating, add-ons, bundles, or regional price laddering.
  • You may bring experience from strategy consulting, product strategy, corporate strategy, pricing, consumer tech, media, or subscription businesses.
  • Familiarity with content or rights licensing, and how it shapes product packaging, would be valuable.

• This role is based in New York or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

We’re building a world-class business development team and are looking for a multi-talented self-starter with ambition and drive who will help grow Spotify’s Premium distribution partnerships in the APAC region. lists.content:
• Identify, structure, negotiate, amend, close, and manage strategic distribution partnerships across APAC that advance Spotify’s growth and long‑term vision.
  • Develop and refine partner strategies for priority markets in collaboration with the regional lead, carrying out detailed partner analysis and setting priorities and forecasts.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for partners, building credibility across all levels—from C‑suite to Marketing to Commercial teams —and owning the full relationship lifecycle.
  • Analyze existing partnerships to unlock additional value, improve performance, and uncover opportunities for expansion.
  • Manage internal approvals including interacting with senior internal executives from relevant functions (e.g., Legal, Finance, Accounting, Product).
  • Drive internal cross‑functional workstreams toward deal objectives, ensuring clarity, alignment, and timely execution.
  • Manage a pipeline of prospective partnerships and assess commercial impact through disciplined analysis and business case development.
  • Travel as needed across APAC to strengthen partner relationships and support deal execution.

• You have a minimum of 5+ years of significant business development or strategic partnerships experience within APAC—ideally across telcos, OEMs, payments, entertainment, or digital platforms.
  • Fluency in English and Korean is required for the role; other additional APAC languages a plus.
  • You have a proven track record of structuring and closing complex deals with large enterprises and scaling partnerships with measurable commercial impact.
  • You understand the nuances of APAC markets and bring relevant local insights; deep experience in Korea, Thailand or Indonesia is especially valuable.
  • You think strategically about complex business issues, yet you’re equally strong in operational execution and relationship ownership.
  • You excel in multicultural, fast‑moving environments and collaborate effectively across distributed teams.
  • You have strong experience negotiating contracts, understanding legal frameworks, and partnering effectively with attorneys.
  • You are comfortable working with product, engineering, and design teams and translate technical concepts to non‑technical team members with ease.
  • You are analytical, data‑driven, and experienced in financial modelling and constructing clear business cases.
  • You communicate with clarity and influence, simplifying complexity for senior audiences internally and externally.
  • You are diligent with strong commercial instincts and the ability to see long‑term value in every opportunity.
  • You demonstrate initiative, resilience, and the ability to independently drive deals from ideation to launch.
  • BA/BS degree with outstanding academic performance; MBA a plus.
  • Experience in using basic AI tools.

• This role is based in either Singapore or Seoul, South Korea.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. 
You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

lists.content:
• Client Strategy: Lead consultative selling to inspire clients and demonstrate how Spotify can achieve their business goals.
  • Business Development: Proactively identify and cultivate high-potential customer relationships across diverse verticals to grow a robust sales pipeline.
  • Sales Propositions: Craft and present effective sales propositions, leveraging the latest platform innovations, research, and key insights.
  • Sales Targets: Own and exceed ambitious revenue goals through strategic, entrepreneurial approaches that drive sustainable growth.
  • Strategic Insight & Reporting: Deliver actionable insights and detailed performance reports, analyzing campaigns to recommend improvements.
  • Product Expertise: Stay ahead of Spotify’s product innovations, identifying cross-selling opportunities to help clients succeed.
  • Pipeline Development: Skillfully manage multiple complex conversations, prioritizing engagements with efficiency using relevant software tools.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Data teams to create comprehensive strategies and optimize platform effectiveness.

• Knowledgeable: You bring a minimum of 5+ years of experience managing pipelines and driving revenue in a digital advertising tech environment. Experience in audio advertising is a plus.

  • Local Market Knowledge: You have a good understanding of the German/DACH advertising, media, adtech landscape, with relevant experience gained either locally or cross-border (like this role) preferred. 

  • Organized & Self-Reliant: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can manage multiple priorities with confidence

  • Articulate: You are an effective communicator, clearly expressing both your stakeholders’ needs and your own.

  • Intrinsically Motivated: You are driven by your own goals and always aim to beat your personal best.

  • Results Oriented: You thrive on exceeding targets and making a tangible impact.

  • Team-Oriented: You believe in collaborative success, eager to learn from your peers and share your expertise.

  • English and German language fluency, spoken and written is required.

  • Please apply with a CV in English.

• This role is based in London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.
  • You’ll be open to periodic travel to Germany for client meetings, events, and team collaboration.

descriptionPlain:
Security engineers at Spotify protect the security of Spotify’s platform and of our 750+ million users. We are looking for an experienced engineer to join us in securing the most important engineering initiatives at Spotify.
You will be working in the infrastructure security engineering area to secure the foundations of Spotify’s platform. We’re a distributed team building the architecture and foundations for secure cloud computing and support platform teams in building best-in-class infrastructure on it. We aim to constantly improve the security posture for our fast-paced and rapidly-changing environment in a manner that will keep up with our scale. We’re experts in many domains of security, willing to teach and learn from anyone at the company.
You are a seasoned security, systems or software engineer with a passion for cloud security. Above all you have an insatiable appetite for learning new things and honing your existing skill set. In this role you are expected to represent security in various engineering and business contexts so we expect you to be comfortable communicating with diverse audiences both verbally and in writing.

In this role you are expected to represent security in various engineering and business contexts so we expect you to be comfortable communicating with diverse audiences both verbally and in writing.

lists.content:
• Champion and contribute to the development and implementation of security best practices, standards, and automated tooling to secure Spotify’s use of cloud computing.
  • Partner closely with teams across the company to integrate security seamlessly into Spotify’s infrastructure, from ideation to deployment and monitoring.
  • Consult, evangelize, and teach theoretical and practical security to groups of varying sizes, disciplines, and experience levels.
  • Drive cross-disciplinary initiatives to improve the security of Spotify’s engineering ecosystem and infrastructure.
  • Conduct threat modeling, security reviews, and risk assessments to make risk-informed security decisions and recommendations.
  • Evaluate, prototype, and integrate security solutions and tools to secure Spotify’s cloud environment.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on the rapidly evolving landscape of security threats, academic research, vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies relevant to Spotify's scale and domain.
  • Contribute to security incident response activities involving Spotify platforms and systems.

• 3+ years of hands-on technical experience with security engineering and cloud computing.
  • Hands-on security experience and expertise with one or more major cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS or Azure.
  • You are confident in automating your work in languages like Python, Java, or Golang with modern software development practices.
  • You are comfortable with infrastructure-as-code and declarative configuration management.
  • You have hands-on experience with operating and securing Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms.
  • Strong foundation with security skills such as cryptography, IAM, threat modeling and software security.
  • You are comfortable working with diverse stakeholders and explaining security concepts to non-expert audiences.
  • You have experience from working in agile environments and easily adapt to change, enjoy challenges and thrive in ambiguity.
  • Experience with applying generative AI tools to security problems and software engineering tasks.
  • Experience integrating security tooling into production systems at scale.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description:
Spotify is looking for a Contractor Music Editor to join our ANZ Editorial team, reporting to the Editorial

Lead in Sydney. This is a 12-month contract role.

Please note this role is employed through a third party.

As a Contractor Music Editor you'll help influence how millions of listeners in Australia and New Zealand experience music on Spotify. Behind the scenes, this role will work with world-leading technology and product teams to sharpen our recommendations and deliver the best possible listening experience for a broad and diverse

Audience.

lists.content:
• Curate engaging playlists and editorial experiences across genres for ANZ audiences, balancing data insight with cultural instinct and human judgement

  • Analyse user behaviour, streaming data and performance metrics to optimise programming and surface audience-growth opportunities

  • Create compelling written commentary, video content and on-camera editorial moments that bring Spotify's editorial voice to life on platform and across social channels

  • Identify emerging music trends, scenes and culturally significant moments — ensuring Spotify's local programming is timely and authoritative

  • Champion local artists and identify export opportunities across Spotify's global editorial network

  • Work cross functionally with other departments within Spotify (including marketing and comms) to realise local market goals and editorial priorities

  • Contribute to the development of creative editorial formats that deepen user engagement and trust

• A minimum of 3+ years of experience in music programming, curation, culture journalism or a related role across digital, radio, music, TV or similar platforms

  • Broad genre expertise with deep knowledge across Dance, Electronic and Hip-Hop looked on particularly favourably

  • Strong understanding of Australian and New Zealand music culture, with the ability to read and forecast cultural trends globally

  • Confident and engaging on camera, with the ability to talk about music with authority and authenticity for a broad audience

  • Excellent written skills — able to craft sharp, compelling commentary on music and culture

  • Deep understanding of digital content, social media and digital culture, with proven experience in engaging with young audiences online

  • Proven experience using AI tools to drive process efficiency and enhance workflows

  • Comfortable using data and analytics to inform editorial decisions and measure performance

  • A keen eye for design and visual storytelling — understanding what makes compelling artwork and playlist imagery

  • Detail-oriented, organised and able to manage a high volume of programming

  • Collaborative, curious and energised by working at the intersection of music, culture and Technology

• This contract is based in Sydney, Australia
  • While there is flexibility to work remotely, attendance at the Sydney office is expected approximately 3 days per week for in-person collaboration

Spotify is looking for a Contractor Content Strategist to join our Korea Marketing team on an 8-month maternity leave cover. This role will help shape how Spotify tells stories around K-Music, artists and fandom by developing creative content ideas, scalable formats, and social-first storytelling approaches.
Working across Marketing, Music, Social & Content, Creative Production and global partners, the role will translate campaign objectives into compelling content ecosystems that resonate with Korean audiences while supporting Spotify's broader business goals.
This role is ideal for someone who is equally passionate about creative strategy, social culture, and content development—and enjoys turning ideas into repeatable formats that can scale across campaigns.
Please note this fixed-term role is employed through a third party.

lists.content:

  • Create scalable content formats and social-first concepts that can be adapted across multiple artists, campaigns and cultural moments

  • Collaborate with Producers and external production partners to ensure creative ideas are executed effectively

  • Work cross-functionally with Korea Music, Social & Content, Creative Production and global marketing teams to develop culturally relevant storytelling

  • Identify emerging content trends, platform behaviors and fan culture across K-Music, proactively bringing new creative opportunities into Spotify's content strategy

  • Help build repeatable content playbooks and best practices that strengthen Spotify's long-term content ecosystem

  • Contribute to both on-platform and off-platform content experiences that deepen fan engagement and strengthen Spotify's cultural relevance

  • Proven experience developing content ideas, formats or creative concepts that drive audience engagement

  • Deep understanding of social platforms, creator culture, and how audiences consume content across different channels

  • Able to think beyond individual campaigns and develop scalable content systems and repeatable creative frameworks

  • Strong collaborator who can bridge creative, production and marketing teams

  • Comfortable working from creative ideation through execution alongside producers and agency partners

  • Passionate about K-Music, including K-Pop and the broader Korean music landscape, with a strong understanding of fandom culture and what resonates with audiences

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly in cross-functional and global environments

  • Experience in music, entertainment, media, agencies or digital platforms is a strong plus

• This role is based in Seoul, Korea

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

descriptionPlain:
Spotify’s Global Communications team is seeking a Corporate Communications Senior Manager, who will support the Global Corporate Communications team in issues management and safeguarding and enhancing Spotify’s brand reputation across markets. The ideal candidate will have experience in corporate communications; has worked with media and creators; and is a determined self-starter who can thrive in a fast-paced, complex organization. 
The senior manager will help support regional market teams around the world in handling sensitive issues and managing narratives as needed. You will work with global teams to help develop and coordinate strategic, integrated communications plans and narratives, utilizing a mix of earned, owned, paid, and social channels. The ideal candidate will have previous experience in global tech companies, be a true team player while accomplishing work autonomously, and bring a proactive approach to their work.

lists.content:
• Lead planning and execution of fully-fledged 360° plans across media types and channels to elevate our corporate stories, aligned and embedded into our local and regional business objectives. 

  • Support the team’s proactive and reactive media relations, and continue building strong relationships with key business, music, and technology press.

  • Craft compelling narratives and messaging around Spotify’s local, regional, and global business strategies.

  • Proactively monitor critical issues relevant to Spotify’s business operations, brand, and reputation and help prepare mitigation and response plans.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with several teams across the company at varying levels across regions and markets.

  • Monitor and analyze media coverage to provide insights and recommendations.

• You have 8+ years of experience working in technology, product or media industries on corporate communications. 

  • You possess a strong understanding of the global media landscape and have established pre-existing relationships with key business and tech media and content creators.

  • You have a proven track record of successful media relations and securing high-impact coverage.

  • You are proactive and results-oriented. You can work efficiently in a fast-paced environment under pressure without sacrificing attention to detail.

  • You are a strong collaborator, team player, and self-motivated, independent worker with a hands-on approach and the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.

  • Established experience coordinating across multi-layered corporate and sensitive projects.

  • A strong written and verbal communicator who is fluent in AI tools.

This role is based in London, UK

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

  •  We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week

descriptionPlain:
Creative Business Strategies (CBS) is Spotify LATAM’s cultural innovation hub. We design and execute cross-functional cultural initiatives that strengthen Spotify’s leadership in Music Culture and power the Creator Flywheel across the region.
 
A core pillar of this role is leading the operation and coordination of the programming at Casa Spotify as a cultural infrastructure in the market. Casa is a permanent, living platform where artists, creators, fans and industry connect through curated experiences that support Spotify’s cultural relevance and business priorities.
 
The CBS Manager works at the intersection of Music, Marketing, Podcast, PR/Comms, Ads and Operations to ensure initiatives are strategically aligned, sustainably executed and meaningfully integrated within Casa Spotify. Content strategy and artist priorities are defined by the respective teams; CBS ensures orchestration, feasibility and operational excellence.
 
This position reports to the Head of CBS LATAM and collaborates closely with local vertical leads as well as the broader CBS regional team.

  • Strengthen Spotify’s presence within the live and cultural ecosystem through consistent, high-quality operational execution.

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

description:
The Social Creative Director will lead the creative vision for Spotify's global social presence, ensuring every piece of content is visually compelling, culturally relevant, and unmistakably Spotify. Working across Brand, Product, Music, Podcasts, Audiobooks, and Fitness, you'll help shape how millions of fans experience Spotify every day through innovative storytelling and world-class creative.

lists.content:
• Lead the creative vision for Spotify's global social channels, delivering innovative, high-quality storytelling that strengthens the brand across Brand, Product, Music, Podcasts, Audiobooks, and Fitness.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (including Social Strategy, Brand, Project Management, and agency partners) to develop and deliver social-first campaigns from concept through execution.
  • Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of creatives, fostering a collaborative, inclusive environment and ensuring creative excellence across every project.
  • Champion consistency by maintaining Spotify's social brand guidelines, developing scalable creative toolkits, and partnering with regional teams to deliver a cohesive global social presence.
  • Stay ahead of emerging social trends, platform capabilities, and audience behaviors, while confidently presenting creative work and recommendations to senior leadership.

• You have at least 10+ years of creative leadership experience in entertainment, technology, media, or consumer brands, with a strong portfolio of social-first work.
  • You have deep expertise in social platforms, content formats, and creative best practices, and know how to turn strategy into engaging, culturally relevant storytelling.
  • You are an experienced people leader who builds strong partnerships, communicates with influence, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • You care deeply about creative quality, bring a solutions-oriented mindset, and inspire teams to produce work that pushes creative boundaries while delivering meaningful business impact.

As AI transforms how creative teams imagine, develop, and produce work, we're looking for a visionary Creative Lead to define what's next. This is an opportunity to shape the future of visual storytelling at Spotify by combining world-class creative leadership with emerging technologies, ensuring every visual experience remains unmistakably Spotify while inspiring audiences around the world.

lists.content:
• Define and evolve Spotify's global visual merchandising vision, setting the creative direction for artwork, visual systems, and brand expression across the Spotify experience.
  • Lead the continued evolution of our creative workflows, identifying how AI can elevate creativity, quality, speed, and scalability while maintaining exceptional craft.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design Platform, and R&D leaders to ensure merchandising and product innovation evolve together.
  • Champion a visual strategy that keeps Spotify culturally relevant across more than 180 markets while balancing global consistency with local expression.
  • Establish creative principles, standards, and scalable systems that empower teams to deliver world-class visual experiences at scale.
  • Build strong partnerships with internal creative teams, external agencies, illustrators, photographers, and freelance talent to expand Spotify's creative capabilities.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Senior Visual Designers by creating an environment built on trust, inclusion, curiosity, feedback, and creative excellence.
  • Own the team's operating budget and prioritize investments that deliver meaningful creative and business impact.
  • Use audience insights, experimentation, and performance data to continuously improve the effectiveness of Spotify's visual merchandising strategy.
  • Represent Visual Merchandising as a trusted creative partner across Spotify, influencing senior stakeholders through thoughtful creative leadership.

• You have 10+ years of experience leading creative work across design, art direction, branding, editorial, advertising, or visual storytelling for a consumer-facing brand.
  • You have experience building, leading, and developing exceptional creative teams while creating an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.
  • You understand how emerging technologies—including generative AI—are transforming creative strategy, production, and design systems, and you're excited by the opportunities they create.
  • You bring exceptional visual craft together with strategic thinking, balancing creativity, business goals, and customer needs.
  • You have experience collaborating across product, design, engineering, marketing, and executive leadership teams to deliver ambitious creative outcomes.
  • You are comfortable using data, experimentation, and audience insights to inform creative decisions without compromising creative quality.
  • You have experience working across global markets and understand how to build creative work that respects cultural nuance while maintaining a strong global brand.
  • You care deeply about mentoring others, raising the creative bar, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.
  • You're naturally curious about design, music, culture, technology, and storytelling, and you're motivated by creating work that reaches millions of people every day.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm 
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify is looking for a senior marketing leader to join our MENAT+ team as Culture Marketing Lead. This is a rare opportunity to define and own the cultural narrative of Spotify across some of the most dynamic and fast-growing markets in the world, including Türkiye, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia.
As part of the Marketing team, you'll lead our culture, content, and experiential marketing efforts, building campaigns at the intersection of music, culture, and community to make Spotify the true home for fans. You'll bring deep expertise in the MENA and Türkiye cultural and creative landscape, along with a proven track record of building brands that authentically move with culture.
Working closely with our Music team, Global Brand teams, artists, creators, and external partners, you'll deliver marketing that fans genuinely love. This role reports to the Head of Marketing, MENAT+ and is based in Dubai.

lists.content:
• Define and lead Spotify's culture marketing strategy across MENAT+, developing campaigns that tap into music, pop culture, and youth culture to grow brand love and cultural relevance.
  • Lead the development and execution of culturally rooted campaigns spanning content, partnerships, creator collaborations, and experiential marketing.
  • Partner closely with Spotify's Music team to develop and execute artist marketing plans and integrated go-to-market campaigns, serving as the primary marketing interface for music and artist-led initiatives across the region.
  • Define the region's content pillars and editorial voice, working across short-form video, long-form storytelling, social-first content, editorial features, and emerging formats to create content that earns attention organically.
  • Build and manage high-impact experiential activations, live events, and fan experiences that connect Spotify to local culture in meaningful ways.
  • Serve as the cultural authority for the region, championing bold, original ideas while ensuring consistency with Spotify's global brand.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Content Marketing Managers, fostering collaboration, creativity, and high performance.
  • Establish measurement frameworks for culture and content marketing, using audience insights and performance data to refine strategy and demonstrate business impact.
  • Stay ahead of cultural trends, shifts in consumer behaviour, and the competitive landscape across MENA and Türkiye, bringing fresh perspectives and outside-in thinking to the team.

• You have 10+ years of experience in marketing, with a significant focus on culture, music, content, and experiential marketing, ideally within entertainment, media, or technology platforms.
  • You are a content strategist at heart and have built content programmes from the ground up, with a deep understanding of how different formats perform across platforms and a strong editorial instinct for what a brand should and shouldn't say.
  • You have extensive experience partnering with music teams, artists, labels, and creative partners, and understand how to balance artist storytelling with brand objectives.
  • You have successfully built, led, and developed high-performing marketing teams.
  • You are deeply immersed in music and culture across MENA and Türkiye, with an authentic understanding of the artists, communities, movements, and cultural moments that shape audiences across the region.
  • You think strategically and culturally, identifying where Spotify should show up and inspiring cross-functional teams and partners around a compelling vision.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, influencing stakeholders, and collaborating across global and regional teams.
  • You are fluent in English and Arabic. Turkish language proficiency is a strong advantage.

• This role is based in Dubai.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


We are looking for a highly motivated individual to support our Customer Success team as a Contractor - Customer Success Manager. 
In this role, you will be responsible for managing campaigns end-to-end across managed and biddable channels — from RFP submission to campaign optimization, upselling and wrap up, while providing proactive consultative client service with a focus on both protecting and growing revenue. This client-facing role includes strategic planning, consultative selling, project management, and data-led storytelling, supported by AI tooling and expertise across our full product suite, including Spotify Ads Manager (SAM). You will be a reliable and crucial market team member who can anticipate and provide solutions to meet ongoing client needs.
 Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts.
Please note this is a fixed-term, 12 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

lists.content:
• Build deep client relationships to deliver best-in-class customer service to Spotify’s advertiser and agency partners.
  • Act as the client’s primary point of contact, fielding requests & questions and communicating directly with clients throughout the sales and campaign lifecycle
  • Be responsible for the RFP response and media planning strategy across all buying channels, including managed, biddable and self-serve
  • Regularly participate in client meetings to deepen relationships via high value client engagement, including campaign prep & launch, ongoing optimization recommendations, campaign reporting, and wrap ups
  • Proactively build and lead Mid and Post Campaign Reports with clients, surfacing actionable insights focused on growth and retention
  • Partner with cross-functional internal organizations to structure campaigns to meet client KPIs and deliver desired outcomes
  • Lead all aspects of the campaign set up, launch and activation processes, across managed and biddable buying channels including creative production management, spec review, asset collection, and ensuring proper creative trafficking 
  • Monitor campaign pacing, delivery and performance reporting and optimize/revise media plans to meet client objectives, leveraging AI tools to drive efficiency in day-to-day workflows
  • Leverage campaign reporting and insights to proactively identify, pitch, and close incremental and expansion opportunities - including multi-product bookings - to help grow the business and support BoB attainment
  • Manage projects involving complex work streams and cross-functional collaboration (internally and externally)
  • Serve as the product expert by educating clients and their agencies on Spotify’s new and existing products - including SAM self-serve and biddable solutions - as well as advising on best practices and bespoke campaign optimization
  • Support SAM self-serve demos and client onboarding to drive platform adoption and expand opportunity coverage
  • Utilise AI tooling to streamline reporting, analysis, and operational tasks, contributing to team-wide efficiency.
  • Actively engage with the quarterly Training & Enablement curriculum to stay current on products, tools, and best practices.
  • Review, interpret and present data, including brand measurement studies, providing comprehensive campaign insights, recommendations, and learnings via effective data storytelling
  • Collaborate cross-functionally on initial billing and revisions to ensure invoices are accurate and delivered on time
  • Adhere to internal best practice guidelines, processes, and operating cadences

• You have a Bachelor's degree, preferably in Sales, Advertising, Marketing, or Business
  • You have a minimum of 6+ years experience in digital media, planning and/or buying
  • Strong industry knowledge and a desire to grow within the digital media industry
  • Strong understanding of advertising performance metrics and the advertising ecosystem, including biddable and programmatic buying
  • You have experience with a strong interest in self-serve advertising platforms and biddable campaign management
  • You have the ability to translate client requests to make recommendations that meet business objectives and deliver desired outcomes
  • You have the ability to craft impactful sales rationale stories by using data and research
  • You are comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity and streamline workflows
  • You are a highly organized and focused multi-tasker with strong attention to detail who can work independently within a team focused organization
  • You have the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and all levels of management (internally and externally)
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, deadline and detailed oriented environment and have excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills
  • You possess strong presentation and communication skills
  • You have excellent dexterity in excel and powerpoint, and have experience working within CRMs, OMSs, ad servers and other digital media tech systems.

• You will work out of our Sydney office
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 times per week
    •

descriptionPlain:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

The Data Infrastructure product area sits at the heart of Spotify’s Platform mission, enabling teams across the company to solve complex data challenges at scale. We build the infrastructure and tooling that powers data pipelines used in some of Spotify’s most loved experiences, like Discover Weekly and Wrapped. As part of this team, you’ll collaborate with engineers across multiple squads to shape the future of data processing and developer experience at Spotify, especially as AI and intelligent agents become more central to how we work with data.

  • Improve the experience for data practitioners by driving best practices, tooling, and standardization across the ecosystem

• This role is based in Toronto.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in-person collaboration, and we expect you to be within a commutable distance to the office.

description:
Within the Data Platform studio, we own two critical pillars: our event delivery platform that collects trillions of events per day from producers to consumers, and another, which handles the pseudonymisation of data so Spotify can use data responsibly and in compliance with privacy regulations. These systems sit at the heart of Spotify's data collection and are used by hundreds of teams across the company.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of six experienced engineers distributed across Europe. You'll set the technical direction, ensure the team delivers high-impact work, and - just as importantly - invest deeply in the growth and careers of your engineers. If you're energised by both the technical challenges of large-scale data systems and the human side of building a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.

lists.content:
• Lead and develop a team of six experienced engineers, with a strong focus on coaching, career development, and creating an environment where people do the best work of their careers.
  • Take accountability for the team's delivery, ensuring clear priorities, healthy execution, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with product and stakeholders to shape the roadmap for event delivery and privacy infrastructure.
  • Drive technical strategy and architectural decisions for systems operating at Spotify scale.
  • Build a culture of ownership, psychological safety, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate across Data Platform and the wider engineering organisation to align on shared goals and dependencies.
  • Manage on-call health, operational excellence, and reliability for the team's services.
  • Actively participate in hiring, onboarding, and growing the team's capabilities.

• You have experience managing teams of senior/experienced engineers and understand that people leadership is your primary craft, not a side responsibility.
  • You have a track record of investing in engineers' careers - running meaningful development conversations, helping people grow into new roles, and creating clarity around expectations and progression.
  • You're comfortable with distributed data systems, event-driven architectures, or data infrastructure at scale - you don't need to write the code, but you can engage credibly in technical discussions and unblock your team.
  • You hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes, not just activity.
  • You communicate clearly and build trust across functions and time zones.
  • You've worked with distributed teams and understand how to create cohesion and inclusion when people aren't in the same room.
  • You're excited about the potential of AI and LLMs to transform how engineering teams work - whether that's accelerating development workflows, rethinking how data infrastructure is built and operated, or helping your team adopt AI-assisted tooling effectively.

• This role is based in London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Think it, build it, ship it, tweak it" is at the core of Spotify's product development approach. In the Experimentation product area we are providing Spotify and external customers with Confidence, our platform to quickly and safely iterate through ideas, learn from them and make informed decisions for better products.
 
At Spotify, experimentation touches almost all of our functions from marketing via content management to consumer products, and we’re running several thousands of tests every year. Through confidence, we 're sharing all our findings and practices with more companies as a commercial SaaS product.
 
The team you will manage is a skilled and highly engaged group of engineers that are distributed over Europe. As an Engineering manager, you coach them individually and as a team, maintaining their strong team culture and helping them thrive and and grow. Your technical experience provides mentorship and guidelines to the team, which ensures quality and timeliness of your deliveries. Your leadership promotes creativity, collaboration and courage, which forms a kind and productive team with a high bar for quality and pace of delivery.

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We’re building one of Spotify’s most social and engaging experiences: Jam. Jam brings people together through music, enabling friends and groups to listen in real time, wherever they are. It transforms listening from a solo activity into a shared experience and plays an important role in how Spotify connects users through audio.
You’ll join a cross-functional team working across mobile, backend, and platform technologies to shape how millions of people experience music together.
