In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration. 

Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.

lists.content:
• Collaborate with a highly autonomous and supportive engineering squad responsible for Spotify’s delegated authorization and session management platforms.
  • Design, build, and evolve critical infrastructure powering Spotify applications and partner integrations using shared C++ libraries and native Swift on iOS.
  • Develop secure, reliable, and performant delegated authorization flows, including token issuance, refresh, revocation, and session lifecycle management across multiple platforms.
  • Partner with client and backend engineers to integrate with core authorization services, token issuance, client registration, and token revocation.
  • Improve how credentials and access tokens are securely stored and managed on-device while balancing security, reliability, and application performance.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Spotify’s authorization frameworks, Spotify-specific implementations, enabling new platforms and product experiences.
  • Drive technical improvements, share knowledge with teammates, and help shape the long-term technical direction of delegated authorization and session management.

• You have strong proficiency in C++, along with experience building native iOS applications in Swift, or you're excited to develop your expertise in Swift while applying your C++ skills.
  • You have experience designing, building, or maintaining security-sensitive systems such as authorization, authentication, token management, credential storage, or related platforms.
  • You bring a systems-thinking mindset and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges that span client and backend technologies.
  • You have a solid understanding of software architecture, secure system design, and modern authorization protocols such as OAuth 2.0.
  • You approach problems thoughtfully, with strong attention to detail and a focus on building secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with engineers across multiple teams and technical disciplines.
  • You have experience working with shared cross-platform codebases and understand how native platform layers interact with common C++ libraries.
  • You enjoy working on large-scale distributed systems where your contributions improve experiences for hundreds of millions of Spotify users.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Come shape the conversational experiences at the heart of Spotify's AI-driven products. You'll design how people talk with Spotify — the flows, the voice, the moment-to-moment interactions that make AI feel natural, useful, and unmistakably Spotify.
This role sits at the intersection of writing and system design. You'll bring sharp editorial instincts and real writing chops, but you'll spend your time designing how conversations work — not producing UI copy. Whether you come from editorial, linguistics, interaction design, or an engineering background with a strong feel for language, you'll have room to experiment, prototype, and define how the next generation of Spotify products talk back.
description:
Come shape the conversational experiences at the heart of Spotify's AI-driven products. You'll design how people talk with Spotify — the flows, the voice, the moment-to-moment interactions that make AI feel natural, useful, and unmistakably Spotify.

This role sits at the intersection of writing and system design. You'll bring sharp editorial instincts and real writing chops, but you'll spend your time designing how conversations work — not producing UI copy. Whether you come from editorial, linguistics, interaction design, or an engineering background with a strong feel for language, you'll have room to experiment, prototype, and define how the next generation of Spotify products talk back.

lists.content:
• Design end-to-end conversational experiences — dialogue flows, turn-taking, state and context handling, error and recovery paths, and multi-turn interactions across Spotify's AI products.

  • Engineer and refine the prompts that drive generative and conversational features, shaping model behavior to produce accurate, reliable, and useful outputs.

  • Translate product requirements into conversational system design — identifying the capabilities (tools, data, actions, UI affordances) a system needs to fulfil user intent, and defining how the model interprets that intent, retains context, and decides what to do.

  • Prototype with large language models to probe model behaviors, constraints, and failure modes, and turn what you learn into more capable experiences.

  • Build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve conversation quality, accuracy, task completion, and user impact.

  • Partner with product managers, engineers, researchers, designers, and the content design team to bring AI systems into cohesive, human-centered products.

  • Define guardrails for safe, reliable model behavior across AI-driven interactions.

  • Help raise the bar for conversation design craft on the team, guiding peers and contributing to shared patterns, evaluation methods, and documentation.

• Technically capable — comfortable working directly with LLMs and code, writing and running evaluations, using structured formats (JSON, YAML, Python), and diagnosing whether a failure is a prompt problem, a system design problem, or a missing capability.

  • Practiced at testing and improving conversational systems or prompts through data, feedback, and experimentation.

  • Energized by ambiguity, creativity, and the challenge of defining new interaction paradigms in a fast-moving AI landscape.

  • A strong writer and editor with excellent editorial judgment, and a distinct feel for voice and character design — how a system's personality is expressed through prompting and behavior, not just word choice.

  • A strong cross-functional collaborator who balances technical possibility with creative vision.

  • Familiar with accessibility, localization, regulatory compliance, and safety in digital experiences.

description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work, creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Our team builds Groove, a platform that helps thousands of employees plan, coordinate, and deliver work across Spotify. From initiative tracking to dependency management and collaborative planning, Groove helps teams stay aligned and execute with confidence.

We're a small, cross-functional engineering team focused on building thoughtful tools that reduce friction and help people do their best work. We move quickly, learn from user feedback, and continuously improve the experiences we build.

lists.content:
• Build and evolve Groove, a fullstack platform that supports planning, collaboration, and execution across Spotify.
  • Design and deliver features including initiative tracking, planning workflows, and dependency management.
  • Work across the stack using React, TypeScript, Java, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) to build end-to-end solutions.
  • Partner closely with product managers and designers to understand user needs and create intuitive, effective experiences.
  • Ensure reliability through testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement in production.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and help respond to production incidents when needed.
  • Improve the performance, scalability, and maintainability of frontend and backend systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while maintaining ownership of quality, correctness, and outcomes.
  • Lead the design and delivery of complex, high-impact features across the stack.
  • Own problems end-to-end, from shaping ambiguous requirements through to production-ready solutions.
  • Help define and evolve architecture across frontend, backend, and infrastructure.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to raising the technical bar across the team.

• You have 5+ years of experience building scalable fullstack applications in production environments.
  • You are comfortable working across frontend and backend technologies and understand how they fit together to create reliable products.
  • You have experience with APIs, distributed systems, and modern web application architecture.
  • You take ownership of the software you build, from implementation through production health and ongoing improvements.
  • You have experience designing systems and influencing technical direction.
  • You communicate clearly and effectively through documentation and collaboration in distributed teams.
  • You write clean, maintainable code that enables others to build with confidence.
  • You use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and validate outputs with sound engineering judgment.
  • You navigate ambiguity with confidence and make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.
  • You enjoy mentoring others, sharing knowledge, and helping teammates grow.
  • You are curious, proactive, and motivated by continuous learning and experimentation.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Legal Counsel with deep expertise in music publishing and copyright licensing to join our Legal Licensing Team. In this role, you will partner closely with Business Affairs, Finance, and Product teams to structure, negotiate, draft complex licensing agreements with CMOs, PROs, and music publishers, and advise on the legal frameworks governing the use of musical works across Spotify’s service.

lists.content:
• Provide strategic and tactical legal advice on music publishing and copyright matters, translating complex legal issues into actionable business guidance.
  • Partner with Business Affairs to structure, draft, and negotiate music CMO, PRO, and publishing licensing agreements.

descriptionPlain:
Our mission on the Advertising Product & Technology team is to build a next generation advertising platform that aligns with our unique value proposition for audio and video. We work to scale the user experience for hundreds of millions of fans and hundreds of thousands of advertisers. This scale brings unique challenges as well as tremendous opportunities for our artists and creators.


We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join the Supply Personalization squad. Supply Personalization focuses on optimizing the volume, timing, and types of ad loads a user receives. By leveraging data, machine learning, causal inference, and large scale online experimentation, we aim to uncover and learn the most effective strategies for enhancing user experiences and driving business outcomes.
 
We are looking for someone with strong expertise in data analysis, online experimentation techniques, and large-scale ML and engineering systems; someone who is motivated by user and business problems as much as they are by technical problems, and who thrives under ambiguity, experimentation, and iteration. You will work directly on an array of product features that drive the optimal user experience for our ads. You will collaborate with our cross-functional teams to ideate, develop, and own complex technical solutions on our ad services technology platforms. As someone who shares our passion for building innovative ad experiences, you'll have a direct impact on how the world uses Spotify.

descriptionPlain:
The Experience team designs Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
The Enrichment & Content Intelligence team sits within Content Platform in the Experience Mission. We build the metadata-resolution and content-enrichment infrastructure that powers how Spotify understands music and video content at global scale. Our systems help answer foundational questions across the platform: which tracks are the same recording, which music videos match which audio tracks, who wrote and performed a song, and how content relationships connect across Spotify’s catalog.
Our infrastructure powers products and experiences used by millions of listeners, artists, and creators every day. From recommendations and charts to royalties and artist tooling, the work we do directly shapes how content is understood and surfaced across Spotify.
We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to help evolve the machine learning systems behind Recording Groups, Music Video Resolution, SongDNA, and the Music Knowledge Graph. This role sits at the intersection of multimodal machine learning, entity resolution, and production-scale engineering, with opportunities to work across audio, video, and metadata understanding problems at massive scale.

lists.content:
• Own and evolve large-scale ML pipelines powering Spotify’s content-resolution systems
  • Lead development of multimodal embedding frameworks supporting multimodal understanding, music video matching, SongDNA
  • Improve entity-resolution systems across music and video content, helping Spotify better understand relationships between recordings, versions, and content formats
  • Design and run experiments to improve precision, recall, and overall content-quality outcomes using offline evaluation, golden datasets, A/B testing, and impact analysis
  • Build scalable ML evaluation and monitoring infrastructure, including standardized datasets, retraining workflows, and continuous improvement systems
  • Contribute to the evolution of the Music Knowledge Graph by improving production ML capabilities, observability, and model lifecycle management
  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and engineering teams across Content Platform and the wider Experience Mission
  • Help shape technical strategy for the squad and contribute to long-term ML direction across the product area
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to a strong culture of technical collaboration and experimentation

• You have solid experience building, deploying, and maintaining machine learning systems in production at scale
  • You have strong experience training, evaluating, and operating ML models using modern frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • You have experience working with multimodal machine learning systems across audio, computer vision, text embeddings, or related domains
  • You understand entity resolution, deduplication, record linkage, or large-scale matching problems, ideally across multiple content modalities
  • You know how to design evaluation systems that balance model quality, operational performance, and real-world impact
  • You are experienced working with large-scale distributed data processing systems and ML infrastructure
  • You communicate effectively across engineering, product, and data science stakeholders
  • You are comfortable leading technical initiatives and influencing engineering direction within a team
  • Experience with Scio, Dataflow, Flyte, BigQuery, or similar distributed processing frameworks is a plus
  • Experience with Scala is a plus
  • Experience with computer vision, video understanding, multimodal embeddings, or recommendation systems is a strong plus

• This role is based in New York City
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description:
Spotify’s Subscriptions Mission focuses on converting listeners into lifelong subscribers by delivering seamless, valuable experiences across pricing, packaging, and customer journeys. We build the systems and tools that power acquisition, retention, and overall subscription growth at scale.

The Messaging Platform powers Spotify’s communications to over a billion users — from push notifications to emails and in-app messages that connect listeners to the content they love. Within this space, the Paloma squad focuses on message optimization: deciding which message reaches which user, through which channel, and at what moment.

We’re evolving how messaging works at Spotify — moving from short-term optimization toward systems that understand long-term user journeys. By combining reinforcement learning approaches with deeper domain signals, we’re expanding how machine learning shapes the entire messaging funnel.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and ship machine learning models that optimize messaging across push, email, and in-app channels
  • Plan and run A/B experiments in a multi-objective environment, balancing conversion, engagement, retention, and reachability
  • Contribute to reinforcement learning systems that optimize for long-term user outcomes rather than immediate interactions
  • Partner with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to define what success looks like and how to measure it
  • Own the full ML lifecycle, from data and modeling to deployment, monitoring, and iteration
  • Integrate ML models with upstream systems, including domain value signals and opportunity generation frameworks
  • Help shape the future of AI-assisted development within the team, exploring how tools can accelerate experimentation and delivery

• You have strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in production environments at scale
  • You are comfortable translating business problems into ML solutions and discussing trade-offs with cross-functional partners
  • You have worked on complex optimization problems such as ranking systems or multi-objective decision-making
  • You bring hands-on experience with PyTorch and distributed systems such as Ray or similar frameworks
  • You understand experimentation deeply and can design reliable tests in environments with interacting metrics
  • You are able to analyze results using approaches like causal inference or metric decomposition when needed
  • You have experience with or curiosity about reinforcement learning and long-term optimization systems
  • You enjoy working across disciplines and navigating ambiguity while shaping strategy and direction

    •

• This role is based in London and Stockholm
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

lists.content:
• You'll build and improve the core agentic capabilities that power the agent behind Talk to Spotify (memory, context management, multi-step tool use)
  • You'll design and calibrate evaluation frameworks (including LLM-as-judge) that accelerate our confidence in the agent's behavior, and increase our offline-to-online success
  •  You'll work in a very dynamic space: the team prototypes, dogfoods, ships, learns, and refines in tight loops with real users, as our understanding of the problem and users' expectations of agentic products and Spotify evolve

• You're excited by agentic experiences — building agents, evaluating agents, and the hard problems in between (context handling, multi-step reasoning, ambiguity at scale)
  • You like getting your hands dirty: shipping quickly, testing ideas against real usage, and learning from the wild rather than over-indexing on offline evaluation
  • You have 5+ years of production ML experience deploying highly impactful products, or equivalent experience in other roles with a deep ML background
  • You know how to evaluate ML systems rigorously — designing metrics, building eval pipelines, judge alignment, and can develop intuition through dogfooding and looking at user behavior
  • You're comfortable debugging the messy interactions between models, tools, and system constraints like latency

• This role is based in New York
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You’ll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale.

lists.content:
• Own and improve the machine learning models and systems that power the Home feed, including the Shortcuts experience.
  • Design, build, and ship personalized recommendations that serve millions of Spotify listeners globally.
  • Build content recommendation systems for emerging agentic and AI-powered user experiences.
  • Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter-efficient training approaches.
  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to define and execute experimentation strategies.
  • Drive A/B testing, monitoring, model evaluation, and continuous optimization of recommendation quality, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale.

• You have 5+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments.
  • You have deep expertise in recommendation systems, ranking models, personalization, or large-scale content discovery platforms.
  • You have strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience building machine learning systems with PyTorch.
  • You are experienced with large language model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization techniques including SFT, distillation, and LoRA.
  • You have worked with large-scale inference systems and understand the challenges of latency, reliability, and cost optimization.
  • You care deeply about creating high-quality user experiences through thoughtful application of machine learning.
  • You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences and enjoy working in highly collaborative environments.
  • You know how to design, execute, and interpret online experiments and A/B tests to improve user outcomes.
  • You have experience operating distributed machine learning workloads using technologies such as Ray, FSDP, HSDP, or similar frameworks.
  • You are experienced building and maintaining data pipelines and orchestration workflows using technologies such as Flyte, Airflow, BigQuery, and cloud-based storage platforms.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.
  • This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

We are seeking a dedicated and dynamic candidate to join Spotify’s EU Government Affairs team in Brussels as Senior Manager - EU Government Affairs. 
The Government Affairs team is charged with understanding the global and local policy landscape in relation to Spotify’s business objectives and advocating on the company’s behalf on critical public policy issues. We represent the company before legislators and regulators, interact with civil society and industry, see around corners, and mitigate potential risks.
In this role you will be an active member and will provide advice and external advocacy on policy matters that have an impact on Spotify in Europe. You will report to our Senior Director of European Policy and will be based in our Brussels office.
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and dynamic candidate to join Spotify’s EU Government Affairs team in Brussels as Senior Manager - EU Government Affairs. 

The Government Affairs team is charged with understanding the global and local policy landscape in relation to Spotify’s business objectives and advocating on the company’s behalf on critical public policy issues. We represent the company before legislators and regulators, interact with civil society and industry, see around corners, and mitigate potential risks.

In this role you will be an active member and will provide advice and external advocacy on policy matters that have an impact on Spotify in Europe. You will report to our Senior Director of European Policy and will be based in our Brussels office.

lists.content:
• Engage regularly with EU policymakers including the Commission, Parliament, Council, and policymakers at national level 
  • Work on the priority public policy issues affecting Spotify in the EU - with a focus on platforms and content regulation, consumer rules, as well as trade and tech regulation in general. You will be responsible for managing these files and developing and implementing effective advocacy strategies. 
  • Work closely with other groups and departments inside Spotify -- including legal, licensing, communications, social impact, compliance and trust and safety -- to understand the priorities of internal partners, and create approaches to key policy issues that advance the interests of Spotify
  • Develop engagement and partnerships with external organizations such as trade associations and civil society organizations

• 10+ years of experience in EU government affairs, for a government/public authority, a company, and/or a trade association
  • Expertise on regulatory issues, especially in the field of platform and consumer regulation
  • Excellent understanding of tech sector and policy, and ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues
  • Mastering of AI tools, such as Claude, Chat GPT, Gemini
  • Strong written and oral communications skills & attention to detail
  • Ability to work with a cross section of stakeholders, including trade associations, companies, civil society
  • Ability to work independently, across time zones and cultures 
  • Full English language proficiency is required
  • Knowledge of an additional EU language (e.g. Dutch, Polish) is a positive asset

• This role is based in our Brussels offices
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 days per Week.

description:
Spotify is looking for a seasoned Senior Manager to join our Finance team to support the evaluation and potential operation of new in person experiences. As Spotify continues to evolve beyond digital streaming, we are exploring initiatives that bridge the gap between our platform’s global reach and the physical-world.

This is a "foundational" finance role responsible for building the investment models, unit economic frameworks, and operational governance for these new initiatives. You will partner with leadership and the business to produce scenario analysis and manage the financial lifecycle of infrastructure and operational investments.

lists.content:
• Modeling: Lead the development of multi-year financial models for capital-intensive projects, managing budgets and long-term recoupment cycles.
  • Unit Economics: partner with the business to determine the appropriate "Single Unit" P&L framework. Analyze revenue drivers (including secondary monetization streams) and cost structures to ensure investments meet IRR and cash flow targets.
  • Strategic Investment Appraisal: Provide financial partnership scenario analysis.
  • Market Entry Analysis: Partner with the business to evaluate commercial structures, and regional economic variables to optimize potential roadmaps.
  • Performance Governance: Establish the reporting infrastructure for these new initiatives, translating operations into clear financial narratives for leadership.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as the primary finance lead for a diverse team of operators across Spotify.

• Experienced Finance Professional: 6+ years in FP&A, Corporate Development, or Investment Banking. Experience in industries with physical footprints (e.g., Real Estate, Hospitality, Retail, or Entertainment) is highly preferred.
  • Sophisticated Modeler: Can build dynamic models that handle complex variables like construction ramp-ups, negative working capital, and lease capitalization and distill models into key assumptions.
  • Trust builder: You have a "sharp eye for detail” along with the ability to influence senior stakeholders both in Finance and across Spotify through clear, data-driven narratives and investment cases.
  • Operational Mindset: You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and building processes from scratch in a fast-paced, flat organizational structure.
  • Systems familiarity: Comfortable automated reporting tools (Netsuite/Adaptive, Workday Financials) and an interest in leveraging AI to drive analytical throughput.

• This role is based in New York, NY
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come into the office 2-3 days per week.
  • Working hours? We operate within the EST zone for collaboration.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Editor for Indonesia, to join Spotify’s Music Editorial team based in Jakarta. In this role you will be part of the Music team in Southeast Asia, reporting to the regional Head of Editorial.
You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, including playlist curation, creative editorial work, and cross-functional collaboration with different teams in the region and beyond. You will provide deep cultural and musical insights to create highly engaging and cohesive music experiences for listeners, extending beyond playlists, while ensuring an unbiased editorial voice for a wide array of moods, moments, and genres. Additionally, you will drive artist discovery through an extensive editorial ecosystem of playlists and tools, critically assessing music trends and user behavior to identify opportunities and emerging trends.
You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify’s role in the music industry both locally and globally. Additionally, you will have an editorial personality that thrives in engaging audiences through creative formats, bringing the playlists to life in innovative ways.
You will be encouraged to make data-informed decisions while also contributing creative and cultural expertise. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape!
description:

You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, including playlist curation, creative editorial work, and cross-functional collaboration with different teams in the region and beyond. You will provide deep cultural and musical insights to create highly engaging and cohesive music experiences for listeners, extending beyond playlists, while ensuring an unbiased editorial voice for a wide array of moods, moments, and genres. Additionally, you will drive artist discovery through an extensive editorial ecosystem of playlists and tools, critically assessing music trends and user behavior to identify opportunities and emerging trends.

You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify’s role in the music industry both locally and globally. Additionally, you will have an editorial personality that thrives in engaging audiences through creative formats, bringing the playlists to life in innovative ways.

You will be encouraged to make data-informed decisions while also contributing creative and cultural expertise. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape!

lists.content:
• Develop and execute a holistic editorial strategy for Indonesia that aligns with regional business goals
  • Shape and evolve our editorial voice across playlists, written and visual storytelling, and short-form content on and off platform
  • Pioneer creative and innovative formats to bring playlists to life and deepen connection with listeners
  • Proactively identify music trends, emerging talent, and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, acting as a cultural guide
  • Curate cohesive, engaging playlists for Indonesia with compelling descriptions and commentary that resonate with audiences
  • Lead editorial representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets at both a regional and global level with teams like artist & label partnerships, marketing, design, PR, and product
  • Maintain and refine a strong playlist ecosystem that supports artist discovery and deepens artist-fan engagement
  • Analyze user behavior and performance data to optimize playlist engagement and make informed editorial decisions, translating high-level insights into actionable initiatives
  • Collaborate with global and regional editorial teams on programming initiatives and strategies to enhance Spotify’s market position.

• At least 8+ years of experience in the music industry, journalism, programming/curating music for digital, radio, TV, or other media outlets
  • You have deep knowledge of music and culture, possessing broad expertise across all genres and styles, from Indo Pop to HipDut, Indie to Javanese music, with the ability to curate music for diverse moods and moments
  • Skilled at leveraging data and audience insights to support editorial decisions and build clear narratives
  • You have a strong editorial voice and are culturally aware, with the ability to critically evaluate music trends, emerging movements, and audience behavior beyond just data
  • A confident storyteller and public speaker, fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia to effectively advocate for the market and secure stakeholder buy-in
  • An excellent communicator, capable of connecting with audiences through written, video, or audio commentary to enhance playlists
  • You’re a team player who is detail-oriented and consistently demonstrates a positive attitude, adaptable and at ease navigating fast-changing priorities in a dynamic environment, comfortable navigating complex global-to-local organizational structures and aligning cross-functional teams around Editorial priorities
  •  You are curious about how technology and culture intersect, constantly exploring new, innovative formats to keep Spotify at the forefront of the cultural zeitgeist
  • You are comfortable on-camera and experienced crafting social-first content and working with video production teams
  • You are knowledgeable of Google Suite tools, comfortable with basic design tools and workflows, capable of creating visual assets like playlist covers when necessary.

• This role is based in Jakarta
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

lists.content:

  • Proactively identify music trends, emerging talent, and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, acting as a cultural guide
  • Curate cohesive, engaging playlists for Taiwan with compelling descriptions and commentary that resonate with audiences
  • Lead editorial representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets at both a regional and global level with teams like artist & label partnerships, marketing, design, PR, and product
  • Maintain and refine a strong playlist ecosystem that supports artist discovery and deepens artist-fan engagement

  •  You are curious about how technology and culture intersect, constantly exploring new, innovative formats to keep Spotify at the forefront of the cultural zeitgeist

• This role is based in Taipei

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design  and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive and unmistakably Spotify.
The In Home Hardware Partners team sits within the Experience Mission and connects Spotify engineering with some of our most strategic hardware partners. We help bring Spotify to connected devices by working closely with partners throughout integration, certification and launch. As the team continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Partner Engineer to help scale our technical partnerships and drive the next generation of Spotify experiences on connected devices.

lists.content:
• Build trusted technical partnerships with strategic hardware manufacturers, including companies developing connected audio products.

  • Lead technical integration projects from planning through launch, helping partners successfully adopt Spotify's Core Playback SDK.

  • Collaborate with engineering, product and cross-functional teams to align priorities, remove blockers and deliver high-quality partner experiences.

  • Drive technical discussions, architecture reviews, workshops and implementation planning with both internal and external stakeholders.

  • Write clear technical proposals, RFCs and design documentation that help engineering teams make informed decisions.

  • Monitor project health, proactively identify risks and coordinate solutions across multiple engineering teams.

  • Investigate and resolve complex SDK, API and integration challenges, contributing code when appropriate.

  • Help improve the tools, processes and developer experience that enable partners to build with Spotify more effectively.

  • Contribute to the long-term evolution of Spotify's hardware platform by identifying opportunities to simplify integrations and scale partner success.

• You have a strong foundation in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • You have 5+ years of experience working in software engineering, partner engineering, developer relations, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.

  • You are experienced with software development, SDKs, APIs, distributed systems or embedded technologies.

  • You can comfortably read, understand, and contribute to production code while discussing technical architecture with engineers and technical partners.

  • You have experience working across organizational boundaries and building strong relationships with both engineering teams and external partners.

  • You know how to navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and keep complex technical initiatives moving forward.

  • You communicate technical concepts clearly, adapting your approach for different audiences without losing technical depth.

  • Experience with consumer electronics, connected devices, smart home products, audio platforms or hardware certification is valuable.

  • Experience writing technical specifications, architecture proposals or RFCs is an advantage.

• This role is based in Stockholm.

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

lists.content:
• Define and drive the long-term product strategy and roadmap for Encore, including design tokens, component libraries, accessibility standards, and AI-powered capabilities.
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, accessibility, and platform teams to evolve the systems that enable product teams to deliver high-quality user experiences consistently and efficiently.
  • Lead prioritization across multiple initiatives, balancing immediate customer needs with long-term platform investments while clearly communicating trade-offs and rationale to stakeholders.
  • Champion the use of AI throughout the product development lifecycle, leveraging AI-powered tools to synthesize research, explore solutions, draft product artifacts, accelerate decision-making, and improve team productivity.
  • Shape Spotify's strategy for AI-enabled design tooling, identifying opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve design workflows, component quality, documentation, and adoption across both human and AI consumers.
  • Establish meaningful success metrics for platform adoption, design quality, accessibility, and developer experience, using both quantitative and qualitative insights to guide investment decisions.
  • Translate strategic objectives into clear execution plans that keep cross-functional teams aligned, focused, and delivering against shared outcomes.
  • Build trusted partnerships across Spotify, helping teams successfully adopt Encore while continuously improving the platform based on user feedback and evolving business needs.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, and accountability across the teams contributing to Spotify's design infrastructure.

• You have 6+ years of experience in Product Management, with significant experience building platform, infrastructure, developer platform, or design systems products.
  • You have successfully defined product strategy for complex, cross-functional initiatives involving platform adoption, migrations, or large-scale technical investments.
  • You use AI tools as a natural part of your product management practice, applying them to research, analysis, documentation, synthesis, prototyping, and decision support while exercising thoughtful human judgment.
  • You have strong analytical skills and experience defining product metrics, interpreting data, and using evidence to inform product strategy and prioritization.
  • You understand the principles behind design systems, accessibility, design tokens, semantic components, and modern design tooling, or you're excited to deepen your expertise in these areas.
  • You communicate complex ideas with clarity, adapting your approach to engineers, designers, executives, and cross-functional partners alike.
  • You know how to influence without authority, bringing alignment across multiple teams with differing priorities.
  • You care deeply about building products that enable others to do their best work, raising the quality, consistency, and accessibility of experiences across Spotify.
  • You thrive in ambiguous environments, bringing curiosity, sound judgment, and a bias toward thoughtful execution.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
User Platform owns Spotify's Consumer and Business Identity & Access Management (IAM) platform. Put simply, we're the front door to Spotify. We build the experiences and capabilities that enable people to securely access Spotify across consumer, creator, business and partner products while helping the rest of the company make trusted decisions using high-quality identity data.
As Spotify continues to grow, our identity platform has evolved well beyond a traditional consumer account model. Today it supports consumers, creators, advertisers, employees, managed accounts, connected devices and emerging AI-powered experiences. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape the next generation of our User Platform strategy across account lifecycle management, IAM analytics, and device and client trust. This is a highly strategic platform role with direct impact on growth, safety, subscriptions, advertising, personalization, compliance and future product innovation.

lists.content:
• Define the product strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of User Platform products spanning account lifecycle management, IAM analytics, and device and client intelligence.
  • Partner closely with engineering managers, staff engineers, data scientists, analytics engineers, designers, researchers and insights teams to shape product direction and deliver long-term platform value.
  • Collaborate across missions, studios and product areas to ensure Spotify's identity and user data platform evolves to meet business and customer needs.
  • Help build Spotify's account lifecycle platform with well-defined account states, governed lifecycle transitions and comprehensive audit capabilities supporting Engineering, Customer Service, Legal and partner teams.
  • Lead the product vision for User Intelligence, the shared platform that enables trusted understanding of users, devices and sessions through reusable signals and APIs.
  • Partner with teams across User Fraud, Subscriptions, Advertising, Personalization, Safety, Legal and Platform to ensure trusted identity data becomes a strategic input for decision making.
  • Translate complex identity, trust and data challenges into clear product strategies, business outcomes and prioritization decisions.
  • Define success metrics including platform adoption, signal quality, data trust, lifecycle diagnosis time, decision latency and reduction of fragmented local solutions.
  • Balance long-term platform investments with near-term business priorities, regulatory requirements and user experience.
  • Foster an effective product operating rhythm across multiple squads by creating clarity, alignment and shared ownership that enables teams to move with confidence.

• You have significant product management experience building platform products, identity systems, infrastructure or large-scale consumer technology.
  • You have experience working with backend platforms, APIs, distributed systems, identity platforms, policy engines or large-scale data products.
  • You care deeply about creating trusted user experiences where security, privacy, safety and usability must work together.

  • You know how to build alignment across diverse stakeholders while maintaining focus on long-term product outcomes.
  • You bring a structured, proactive approach and are comfortable creating clarity from complex and evolving challenges.

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
 
At Spotify, we’re building the best way to experience audio and video — everywhere, every time. As listening and watching on TV continues to grow, we’re investing deeply in native, video-first playback experiences that are fast, reliable, and feel effortless.
 
The Native Playback team sits at the heart of Spotify’s TV strategy. We integrate Spotify’s playback experience with the native players and media frameworks available on each platform. Our work happens close to the system — where performance, reliability, and quality truly matter — and directly impacts how millions of people experience Spotify every day.

Our work happens close to the system — where performance, reliability, and quality truly matter — and directly impacts how millions of people experience Spotify every day.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and evolve the C++ integration layer that powers Spotify’s audio and video playback on TV devices running our new Rust runtime
  • Integrate Spotify’s playback experience with platform-native media frameworks such as AVPlayer, ExoPlayer, or equivalent TV player stacks
  • Own critical playback areas including buffering strategies, playback state handling, A/V synchronization, adaptive bitrate configuration, track selection, and rendering paths
  • Debug complex performance and reliability issues across multiple layers — from application logic to OS-level frameworks and hardware acceleration
  • Partner closely with Playback platform teams and device teams to ensure shared APIs and designs translate cleanly into real-world TV implementations
  • Improve test coverage, tooling, and observability to detect regressions and speed up iteration cycles
  • Contribute to thoughtful technical design discussions and raise the bar for playback quality through code reviews and knowledge sharing

• You have strong of experience building low-level systems in C++, ideally within video, media, or playback domains
  • You have hands-on experience integrating native playback frameworks such as AVPlayer, ExoPlayer, vendor SDKs, or similar media stacks
  • You have a deep understanding of video playback fundamentals including codecs, streaming formats, adaptive bitrate (ABR), buffering behavior, and A/V synchronization trade-offs
  • You are comfortable working close to the OS and media framework layer and diagnosing issues that span multiple system boundaries
  • You have experience contributing to the design and evolution of scalable technical systems across platforms
  • You are confident debugging performance and reliability issues using logs, traces, profilers, and system diagnostics tools
  • You collaborate effectively across teams and communicate technical trade-offs clearly
  • You care deeply about delivering reliable, high-quality playback experiences for millions of users

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best. While some in-person collaboration is expected, you’ll also have the option to work from home.

The Content Platform team powers the full lifecycle of content across music, podcasts, audiobooks, and emerging formats at Spotify. We ensure that everything from licensed catalog to user-generated content is trusted, safe, and high quality for millions of listeners worldwide. Our systems are responsible for how content is ingested, understood, enriched, governed, and distributed across the platform. As the scale and diversity of content continues to grow, driven by advances in AI and new creation tools—we’re investing in systems that ensure content remains safe, compliant, and high quality.

This work is critical to maintaining trust for both listeners and creators.

lists.content:
• Own the day-to-day management of strategic partnerships from post-signature through renewal or conclusion, partnering closely with Business Development, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, building trusted relationships and delivering an outstanding partner experience.
  • Lead partner launches by coordinating timelines, managing operational activities, and resolving issues quickly and effectively.
  • Build strong relationships across partner organizations through regular business reviews, performance discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
  • Collaborate with partners to develop and optimize marketing initiatives that increase awareness, drive user acquisition, and support conversion from Free to Premium.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing partnerships and support the successful launch of new products and services.
  • Partner with Product Operations to identify feature enhancements, process improvements, and workflow efficiencies that improve partner management at scale.
  • Analyze campaign performance, customer behavior, and business metrics to generate actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and commercial outcomes.
  • Share insights, learnings, and best practices across internal teams to influence future partnership strategies, product improvements, and commercial opportunities.

• You have 6+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, partner management, alliance management, global account management, or subscriber acquisition.
  • You bring experience from one or more of the following industries: management consulting, telecommunications, media, content distribution, or subscription-based consumer products or services, with strong knowledge of the European market.
  • You understand commercial agreements, operational processes, marketing channels, and the metrics that drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.
  • You have experience collaborating across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and Business Development teams.
  • You build trusted relationships and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, using influence and collaboration to drive successful outcomes.
  • You enjoy solving complex problems, take ownership of your work, and adapt confidently in fast-changing environments.
  • You use data to inform decisions, identify opportunities, and develop compelling recommendations that support business growth.
  • You know how to prioritize competing initiatives while maintaining strong attention to detail and delivering high-quality work.
  • You communicate clearly, present ideas confidently, and collaborate effectively across distributed teams.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify is looking for an exceptional Social Marketing Manager to lead our social marketing efforts across the UK and Ireland, while providing strategic oversight and guidance for the Netherlands market. We're seeking a social-first marketer with a deep passion for music culture, audience behaviour, and storytelling — someone who can think strategically while also driving day-to-day execution across channels.
You bring a proven track record of developing impactful social strategies, creating culturally resonant content, and building engaged communities. You understand platform dynamics, know how to identify opportunities within emerging trends, and can translate audience insights into compelling campaigns that drive engagement, growth, and brand affinity.
In this role, you'll collaborate across Marketing, Music, Podcasts, Audiobooks, PR & Communications, Artist Partnerships, and local market teams to bring Spotify to life for fans across multiple markets. You'll help position Spotify at the center of culture, connecting audiences with the artists, creators, and experiences they love.

lists.content:
• Oversee the planning and execution of a dynamic social media content strategy for the UK and Ireland, leveraging platforms to build community, spark conversation, and increase brand engagement with relevant audiences. Identify trends, optimise content for each platform, and collaborate with influencers and creators to expand reach.

  • Manage our key agency partner fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, and accountability. Ensure high-quality execution that aligns with the brand’s vision and strategic goals.

  • Optimise with the use of paid media.

  • Provide strategic oversight and direction for the Netherlands social marketing, ensuring alignment with broader global brand strategy, sharing best practices, and supporting cross-market campaign activations.

  • Participate in the adaptation, creation and execution of innovative, multi-channel marketing campaigns that amplify our brand, content, and partnerships across all three markets.

  • Collaborate closely with our Music and Podcast team to ensure that all content created for our brand is culturally relevant and adheres to our channel guidelines. Develop a keen understanding of the local music community, industry and fans, particularly the nuances of UK and Irish music culture, audience sensibilities, and social behaviour.

  • Define and strengthen our brand identity, ensuring consistency across all marketing touchpoints. Develop culturally resonant campaigns and initiatives that reflect our commitment to diversity, music discovery, and audience connection.

  • Build and nurture relationships with creators  and relevant players in the UK and Irish cultural landscape to expand the platform’s reach. 

  • Harness data insights to drive engagement with key audience segments, especially Gen Z. Analyse marketing performance metrics to measure ROI, identify opportunities, and optimise campaigns. Stay dialled in to social sentiment and report trends to key stakeholders.

  • Stay informed of industry trends, emerging platforms, and audience behaviour to adapt strategies as needed.

  • Lead on social roll out across live experiences and hero campaigns across both paid and organic

• 7+ years in social marketing, ideally within the music, entertainment, or content industries.

  • A strong sense of brand identity and creative vision, with the ability to present and advocate for ideas effectively.

  • Deep knowledge of UK social media culture and audience behaviour — including an understanding of how UK and Irish consumers engage with content across platforms, the cultural moments and conversations that resonate.

  • Demonstrable experience managing social channels for a market, with a clear grasp of regional differences in content preference, platform usage, and engagement patterns.

  • Proven ability to cultivate strong, trusting, and transparent working relationships at all levels of an organisation.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-pressure environments, managing tight deadlines, shifting priorities, and real-time decision-making with ease.

  • Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented, with a collaborative mindset to navigate ambiguity and evolving situations effectively.

  • Well-versed in the music industry, including emerging trends, influential artists, and cultural movements, particularly within UK and Irish music scenes.

  • Experience working across international markets or with culturally diverse teams; experience with or knowledge of the Netherlands or Benelux market is a plus.

  • A genuine passion for music, coupled with a strong awareness of cultural trends and dynamics.

• This role is based in London.

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

  • We ask that you come into the London office 3 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
Spotify's Financial Engineering (FinE) organization ensures that as Spotify grows, our financial systems grow with it. We build the infrastructure and tooling that finance teams across the company depend on to track revenue accurately, report reliably, and reconcile at scale.
The Oracles team sits at the heart of Spotify's financial infrastructure, building the data pipelines and backend services that power our subledger and accounting lifecycle. As part of a broader Financial Engineering initiative, we're standardizing and scaling how accounting data flows across Spotify. You'll partner with engineers, finance teams, and product managers to build reliable, scalable systems that simplify complex financial processes.
We're looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys building reliable, data-intensive systems. You'll help shape the future of Spotify's financial data platform by designing robust data models, developing scalable backend services, and building high-volume data pipelines that power critical financial workflows.

lists.content:
• Build, operate, and evolve scalable Scio data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform that process high-volume financial data with accuracy and reliability.
  • Develop and enhance Java backend services that power integrations across Spotify's financial ecosystem.
  • Design and evolve data models and datasets that support accounting, reconciliation, financial reporting, and operational insights.
  • Build and improve integrations with external financial systems to bring critical financial data into Spotify's financial ecosystem.
  • Partner closely with Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to translate accounting requirements into reliable, scalable technical solutions.
  • Improve the scalability, observability, and resilience of financial data pipelines and backend services.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices through continuous delivery, automated testing, monitoring, and thoughtful code reviews.
  • Help drive technical decisions that improve the long-term maintainability of Spotify's financial engineering platform.

• You have 3+ years of professional experience building backend systems and data-intensive applications.
  • You are experienced with Scala or Java and at least one distributed data processing framework such as Scio, Apache Beam, Spark, or Flink.
  • You know how to design and build reliable backend services and scalable data pipelines that support business-critical workflows.
  • You have experience designing data models that enable accurate, high-volume financial processes.
  • You have worked with workflow orchestration platforms such as Flyte, Airflow, or similar technologies.
  • You care deeply about engineering fundamentals, including continuous delivery, automated testing, monitoring, and writing production-quality code.
  • You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional partners and translating complex business requirements into elegant technical solutions.
  • Experience working within financial, accounting, or other regulated data domains is a plus.
  • A Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field is a plus.

• This role is based in Toronto.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in-person meetings, while still allowing flexibility to work from home.

description:
Spotify is on an ambitious path to reach one billion users and $100 billion in revenue, and the Subscriptions User Understanding team plays a key role in making that possible.

Our team builds the foundational data platform that helps Spotify understand conversion, retention, engagement, and subscriber health for more than 200 million Premium subscribers around the world. We enable better decisions across analytics, experimentation, machine learning, and product development.

We're looking for a Staff Data Engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strategic thinking. You'll help define the long-term direction of our data ecosystem, influence engineering across multiple teams, and build the foundations that will scale with Spotify's future.

lists.content:
• Define and drive the long-term data engineering strategy for the Subscriptions User Understanding domain, identifying opportunities that improve scalability, reliability, and business impact.
  • Design scalable batch and streaming data platforms that power analytics, experimentation, machine learning, and subscriber experiences.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Platform teams to turn complex business challenges into durable, well-designed data solutions.
  • Lead architectural decisions and establish engineering best practices for data quality, governance, observability, reliability, and operational excellence across multiple squads.
  • Design data models and platform architecture that support sustainable growth toward one billion users while balancing performance, cost, and maintainability.
  • Simplify complex systems, reduce technical debt, and improve the developer experience across the broader data ecosystem.
  • Mentor senior engineers, influence technical direction through collaboration, and help foster a culture of thoughtful engineering, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

• You enjoy solving broad, cross-cutting engineering challenges and bringing teams together around a shared technical vision.
  • You have extensive experience designing, building, and operating large-scale cloud-native data platforms.
  • You have deep experience building reliable distributed data pipelines using technologies such as Scio, BigQuery, Dataflow, GCS, SQL, Python, or similar cloud-native tools.
  • You have a strong understanding of modern data modeling, metadata management, governance, and data quality practices.
  • You know how to balance immediate business needs with long-term architectural sustainability.
  • You influence technical direction through strong communication, sound judgment, and collaboration rather than formal authority alone.
  • You communicate effectively with engineers, product managers, data scientists, analysts, and senior leadership.
  • You enjoy mentoring engineers and helping technical teams grow through coaching, technical guidance, and thoughtful feedback.
  • You are motivated by building platforms that directly influence Spotify's long-term subscriber growth and business success.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location (excluding France due to on-call restrictions).
  • This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zone for collaboration.

description:
The Experience team designs Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Content Intelligence Product Area is a core part of Spotify’s Content Platform within the Experience mission. We build systems that create deep, machine-readable understanding of content across audio, video, text, and images before it reaches users. This enables automation, safety, and entirely new product experiences. Our work powers content enrichment, quality analysis, annotation platforms, and scalable intelligence systems that allow teams across Spotify to build without needing direct content understanding expertise.

We’re now looking for a Staff Engineer to help build and scale foundational infrastructure powering content understanding across Spotify. This role sits at the intersection of backend systems, ML infrastructure, distributed data systems, and AI-enabled platform capabilities. You’ll help shape infrastructure strategy across the product area while partnering with senior engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional teams to execute on long-term technical investments.

lists.content:
• Lead the design and evolution of data, backend and ML infrastructure systems powering Spotify’s content intelligence capabilities

  • Build scalable infrastructure for multimodal content processing across audio, video, text, and image understanding pipelines

  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and senior engineers to shape technical strategy across the Content Intelligence Product Area

  • Drive architectural decisions across distributed systems, ML infrastructure, data processing platforms, and platform reliability

  • Improve infrastructure supporting AI and LLM-enabled workflows, including podcast and audiobook transcript processing, metadata enrichment, and content understanding systems

  • Develop reliable and cost-efficient systems for high-throughput content processing and real-time intelligence use cases

  • Collaborate across organizational boundaries to drive alignment, technical quality, and long-term platform investments

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to raising the engineering bar across the organization

• You have extensive experience building and scaling large-scale backend and infrastructure systems in distributed environments

  • You have strong technical judgment and can balance scalability, reliability, cost, and product needs effectively

  • You have strong programming experience in Java, Python, and/or Scala

  • You understand the challenges of building systems that process high-volume multimedia or real-time workloads

  • You have worked with systems and products that use AI and LLMs at large scale and can demonstrate direct experience in building such products. You can demonstrate a good understanding of the quality scale and cost trade-offs of these technologies.

  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and helping shape technical direction from the ground up

  • You communicate effectively across engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders

  • You have experience leading complex technical initiatives that span multiple teams or organizational areas

  • You care deeply about collaboration, mentorship, and creating alignment across teams

  • Exposure to search infrastructure, recommendation systems, or audio processing systems is a strong plus

  • Experience working in startup environments or early-stage product areas where ownership and adaptability are critical is highly valued

• This role is based in London or Stockholm

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description:

Our work powers content enrichment, quality analysis, annotation platforms, and scalable intelligence systems that allow teams across Spotify to build without needing direct content understanding expertise.

We’re now looking for a Staff Engineer to help build and scale foundational infrastructure powering content understanding across Spotify. This role sits at the intersection of backend systems, ML infrastructure, distributed data systems, and AI-enabled platform capabilities. You’ll help shape infrastructure strategy across the product area while partnering with senior engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional teams to execute on long-term technical investments.

lists.content:
• Lead the design and evolution of data, backend and ML infrastructure systems powering Spotify’s content intelligence capabilities

  • Build scalable infrastructure for multimodal content processing across audio, video, text, and image understanding pipelines

  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and senior engineers to shape technical strategy across the Content Intelligence Product Area

  • Drive architectural decisions across distributed systems, ML infrastructure, data processing platforms, and platform reliability

  • Improve infrastructure supporting AI and LLM-enabled workflows, including podcast and audiobook transcript processing, metadata enrichment, and content understanding systems

  • Develop reliable and cost-efficient systems for high-throughput content processing and real-time intelligence use cases

  • Collaborate across organizational boundaries to drive alignment, technical quality, and long-term platform investments

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to raising the engineering bar across the organization

  • You have worked with systems and products that use AI and LLMs at large scale and can demonstrate direct experience in building such products. You can demonstrate a good understanding of the quality scale and cost trade-offs of these technologies.

  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and helping shape technical direction from the ground up

  • You communicate effectively across engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders

  • You have experience leading complex technical initiatives that span multiple teams or organizational areas

  • You care deeply about collaboration, mentorship, and creating alignment across teams

  • Exposure to search infrastructure, recommendation systems, or audio processing systems is a strong plus
