description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.


Surfaces Moments is a ML team within the Personalization Mission focused on creating moment-based experiences across Spotify surfaces. The team owns and evolves the experiences that help listeners quickly connect with the content that matters most to them, including the Home Shortcuts experience and the underlying intelligence that powers it. By combining cutting-edge machine learning, recommendation systems, and product thinking, the team delivers highly relevant, personalized experiences to millions of listeners around the world.


As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, driving technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale.

lists.content:
• Own and improve the machine learning models and systems that power the Home feed, including the Shortcuts experience.

  • Design, build, and ship personalized recommendations that serve millions of Spotify listeners globally.

  • Build content recommendation systems for emerging agentic and AI-powered user experiences.

  • Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter-efficient training approaches.

  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to define and execute experimentation strategies.

  • Drive A/B testing, monitoring, model evaluation, and continuous optimization of recommendation quality, reliability, and cost efficiency.

  • Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale.

  • Drive technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and contribute to the long-term architecture of personalization systems.

  • Mentor and support other machine learning engineers, helping raise the bar across the team.

• You have 8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments.

  • You have deep expertise in recommendation systems, ranking models, personalization, or large-scale content discovery platforms.

  • You have strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience building machine learning systems with PyTorch.

  • You are experienced with large language model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization techniques including SFT, distillation, and LoRA.

  • You have worked with large-scale inference systems and understand the challenges of latency, reliability, and cost optimization.

  • You care deeply about creating high-quality user experiences through thoughtful application of machine learning.

  • You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, and you influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team

  • You know how to design, execute, and interpret online experiments and A/B tests to improve user outcomes.

  • You have experience operating distributed machine learning workloads using technologies such as Ray, FSDP, HSDP, or similar frameworks.

  • You are experienced building and maintaining data pipelines and orchestration workflows using technologies such as Flyte, Airflow, BigQuery, and cloud-based storage platforms.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.

  • This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

descriptionBody:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.


Surfaces Moments is a ML team within the Personalization Mission focused on creating moment-based experiences across Spotify surfaces. The team owns and evolves the experiences that help listeners quickly connect with the content that matters most to them, including the Home Shortcuts experience and the underlying intelligence that powers it. By combining cutting-edge machine learning, recommendation systems, and product thinking, the team delivers highly relevant, personalized experiences to millions of listeners around the world.


As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, driving technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale.

lists.content:
• Work closely with our internal stakeholders, Partner Marketing, Product and the Business Development Managers- assume day-to-day ownership of the partner lifecycle, from post signing through to renewal or termination
  • You will be the ‘single threaded owner’ and ‘go to’ person for the partner’s needs; leading marketing conversations to drive incremental users and awareness, managing launch timelines and vendor/supplier payment, and being quick on your feet to problem solve issues that arise
  • Build deep relationships with key partners and their organizations so that we are a preferred and trusted partner. This includes regular partner check-ins to discuss performance and suggest optimizations that match our needs with theirs to grow the business
  • Evaluate, seek and secure incremental opportunities that drive awareness of new products and conversion of free to paid
  • Work closely with our product operations team to clearly define missing features or enhancements that will influence the build out of account management tools and workflows into our partner portal, allowing this team to be more efficient in servicing a large and diverse set of partnerships
  • Actively work with partners to influence their marketing plans and execution, including analyzing marketing channels, target audiences and campaign metrics and follow-up with appropriate optimization measures
  • Work closely with internal teams at Spotify to collect and share insights and learnings that can be used to optimize and elevate partner activities and help inform future deal renewals

• You have at least 6+ years of experience in strategic partner management, alliance management, global account management or subscriber acquisition
  • Your background is in one or several of the following: management consulting, content distribution, media, telecom, and app or subscription based consumer services/products with extensive knowledge of the India market
  • Knowledge of deal and operational terminology, marketing channels, important marketing and growth metrics
  • Experience working closely with cross functional teams such as marketing, product and tech
  • Able to influence internal and external senior management and cross-functional stakeholders to drive positive outcomes for Spotify, Partners and our Users
  • Willing to roll up your sleeves when needed, love for problem solving, and geared towards taking the initiative to get things done
  • Comfortable with taking risks and navigating ambiguity - leaning on data to guide decisions and build insights to support the growth of the business
  • Strong analytical mindset and personality - you know how to identify the right data and how to interpret it to build compelling cases to fix problems and grow the business
  • Skilled at prioritization, effective communication and collaboration amongst teams 
  • Comfortable working in a distributed/remote environment with occasional travel to meet with teams and partners
  • Solid presentation skills and able to articulate key points to stakeholders
  • Experience dealing with telcos is a plus 
  • Experience using AI tools is a plus

• This position will be based in Mumbai, India
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 times per week

description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Want to be part of a billion-dollar business running some of the biggest SaaS installations globally? Spotify is looking for a Systems Manager to lead our Financial Systems Functional Analysis team — a talented group of Functional Analysts and quality specialists responsible for shaping, delivering, and assuring the financial solutions that underpin Spotify's global business.

You’ll join the FinE Alliance within the Platform Mission, partnering closely with Finance teams across Controllership, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Procurement, and Payroll, as well as Engineering and Operations peers across Financial Engineering. This is a highly collaborative leadership role where you’ll help scale our financial systems capability, drive operational excellence, and enable Spotify’s continued global growth through modern SaaS and engineered solutions.

lists.content:
• Lead, develop, and support a team of Functional Analysts and quality specialists, creating an environment focused on delivery excellence, growth, and collaboration.

  • Own the delivery lifecycle for finance-domain initiatives, from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, stakeholder sign-off, and operational handover.

  • Set the standard for high-quality Functional Analysis across the team, including requirements documentation, solution design, vendor engagement, stakeholder management, and operational readiness.

  • Partner closely with Engineering and Operations teams to ensure seamless delivery across a hybrid SaaS and custom-built ERP ecosystem.

  • Drive strategic initiatives supporting Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Tax, Treasury, and related global finance processes.

  • Shape solution architecture decisions for complex, cross-functional financial systems initiatives with high business visibility and impact.

  • Foster analytical excellence and act as a trusted bridge between Finance stakeholders and technical teams.

  • Manage vendor relationships across the systems portfolio, including roadmap discussions, escalations, contract reviews, and vendor performance management.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, including opportunities to leverage automation and Generative AI to improve team scalability and delivery efficiency.

  • Define and track team KPIs, delivery metrics, and operational performance indicators to guide prioritization and resourcing decisions.

  • Serve as an escalation point for complex finance systems issues, stakeholder concerns, and vendor-related challenges.

  • Support SOX and ITGC compliance activities, audit readiness, and change management processes across the systems your team delivers and operates.

• You have 8+ years of experience in financial systems delivery, functional analysis, or enterprise applications within large-scale ERP environments such as NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Workday, or similar platforms.

  • You have 5+ years of people management experience and a strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing analysts across multiple seniority levels.

  • You are an experienced coach and mentor who genuinely enjoys helping people grow and succeed.

  • You have led complex finance systems initiatives end-to-end, including requirements gathering, stakeholder alignment, configuration, testing, deployment, and operational adoption.

  • You have deep functional knowledge across enterprise finance processes including Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC), Record-to-Report (RTR), Tax, and Treasury operations.

  • You are experienced partnering with senior stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, Tax, Treasury, and FP&A functions in global organizations.

  • You have experience managing SaaS vendor relationships, including roadmap planning, escalations, and contract-related discussions.

  • You understand SOX frameworks and IT General Controls as they relate to ERP and SaaS change management and audit readiness.

  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and translating high-level business goals into practical team priorities and delivery plans.

  • You communicate clearly and transparently, building trust across teams and stakeholders.

  • You are experienced working within Agile environments and using tools such as Jira for delivery tracking and prioritization.

  • You bring strong judgment, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset to solving complex operational problems.

  • You have experience working with or exploring Generative AI capabilities to improve delivery effectiveness and operational scale.

  • You have experience supporting both project delivery and operational systems administration responsibilities within a single team environment.

  • You may have an accounting qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent professional

• This role is based in Toronto.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


Spotify's US Agency Team delivers innovative strategic partnerships for our agency partners and their advertiser clients to build trust, drive business outcomes, and maximize long-term local market revenue. Our team sits at the intersection of media, technology, and commercial strategy, helping agency partners navigate the rapidly evolving future of advertising. The team partners closely with Trading, regional/local Sales, Business Marketing, Category Development, and of course, our senior-level partners at the Agencies and Brands. We are skilled cross-functional collaborators, strong communicators at the helm of agency and brand knowledge centers, and innovation drivers who operate with measurable results in mind.

We are looking for a highly motivated US Agency Development Lead to oversee the 1:1 strategic partnership with one of our major Agency partners. You will also support the development and implementation of scaled strategic Agency programs, in collaboration with our internal partner teams. You won't just build partnerships, you'll build and implement joint business plans and scaled initiatives that drive results.

lists.content:
• Oversee the symphony of internal and external partnership stakeholders, serving as the main point of contact for Agency partnership teams
  • Identify new opportunities for revenue growth and build an action plan to drive this revenue growth accordingly
  • Own the development and implementation of the JBP priorities in collaboration with Trading, Sales, and various other cross-functional partners
  • Partner with Agency Trading, Investment, Activation, and Product teams to accelerate adoption of Spotify's automation, self-service, and programmatic buying solutions.
  • Strategically advise cross-functional partners on Agency needs to open new paths for revenue growth; identify gaps, opportunities and share successes
  • Serve as a strategic consultant on emerging areas including Ads Manager, programmatic, measurement, data collaboration, AI-enabled workflows, and evolving agency operating models.
  • Evangelize Spotify and Spotify Advertising initiatives with partnership stakeholders at the Agency with the aim of keeping them our most-informed partners
  • Expertly own internal and external partnership communications, including market updates, toolkits, partnership playbooks and reporting
  • Spearhead our internal community of cross-functional partners supporting these agencies and advertisers so we can maximize our efforts for complex projects
  • Project manage the execution of scalable programs including education programs, data/insights workstreams, tool management, and other innovation-driven programs across various other Agency Initiatives as identified by our team
  • Help inform future partnership development and innovation program initiatives as we continually grow and develop our team

• You have 8+ years of experience driving revenue growth, strategic partnerships, and business development across media platforms, advertising technology, or related fields
  • Experience working with major Agency holding companies and/or platform-based media, advertising technology, programmatic, or digital advertising businesses is strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of modern digital media buying ecosystems, including self-service advertising platforms, programmatic, ad tech, data-driven activation, and measurement solutions.
  • Strategic operator with a service mindset. Excited about helping others drive success
  • High emotional intelligence and self-awareness, which encourages positive energy and passion throughout the organization and with our external partners
  • Strong executive presence, confidently engaging key decision makers and C-level and mid-level executives, inside and outside of Spotify
  • Equally comfortable discussing commercial strategy with Agency executives and technical platform capabilities with Trading, Activation, Product, and Operations teams.
  • Comfortable with working through ambiguity, with an expert ability to navigate sophisticated, matrixed organizations, demonstrating their ability to influence others and build trust
  • Passion for developing and delivering high-impact presentations and leading education programs for large audiences
  • Comfortable discussing advertising technology, automation, measurement, data collaboration, and AI-driven workflows with both commercial and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising platforms, audience and measurement solutions, automation, programmatic buying, and data-driven activation, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for agency and advertiser stakeholders.
  • Success in this role requires a strong understanding of how modern advertising is bought, including automation, self-service platforms, programmatic activation, data-driven optimization, and emerging AI-enabled workflows. The ideal candidate views advertising through the lens of platforms, technology, automation, and data-driven activation and can help agencies evolve how they plan, buy, and optimize media in an increasingly automated ecosystem.

• This role will be out of our NYC office.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
  • We ask that you come into the office 2–3 times per week.
